jobs.title: Account Manager, CRO
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, fostering strong relationships and understanding their business objectives. Conduct regular meetings and communication with clients to gather feedback and provide updates
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drives alignment across design, development, and strategy teams through clear briefs, timelines, and acceptance criteria, ensuring seamless handoffs and execution.
  • POD Coordination & Alignment: Act as the central coordinator across the pod, partnering with Account Directors and assigning tasks to designers and developers to ensure efficient execution. Align priorities, manage resource allocation, and ensure all team members have clear direction, timelines, and requirements to successfully deliver against client goals.
  • Communication & Transparency: Communicate project status, updates, and recommendations clearly to clients and internal teams. Own all client communication and ensure stakeholders are consistently informed and aligned.
  • Client Portfolio: Manages a portfolio of 5–10 clients simultaneously, owning relationships, delivery, and performance across accounts of varying size, complexity, and scope, while maintaining responsibility for a book of business contributing ~$27K+ in monthly recurring revenue and ensuring high-quality service, retention, and growth. Effectively balances high-touch and lower-touch clients by prioritizing time and resources based on client needs, revenue impact, and growth opportunities.
  • Proactive Account Leadership: Anticipates client needs, identifies growth opportunities, and surfaces risks early, bringing forward recommendations and solutions without being prompted.
  • Client Retention: Maintain 90% of MRR from your client book of business
  • Team Support: Step in to lead as AM across other accounts outside of your book of business when deemed necessary
  • AI & Technology Utilization: Leverage AI tools (e.g., for task automation, summarization, QA, and insight generation) to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance output quality.
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department.
  • Market Knowledge: Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to provide valuable insights to clients

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Relationship & communication: Acknowledges all client Slack/email messages within 2-3 business hours and provides substantive updates within 1 business day. Share agendas 24 hrs before calls and send meeting recap + action items within 24 hrs after.
    • How they get there: Demonstrates exceptional account leadership by gaining trust and providing support to their accounts. Owns client communication by keeping every stakeholder up to date, both internal & external.
  • Resource & tools management: Maintain operational excellence across projects by achieving 90% on-time delivery of tasks in Asana each month; ensure 100% ticket hygiene (every active ticket must include acceptance criteria, links/assets, owner, estimate, due date, and status).
    • How they get there: Must be able to coordinate the resources accordingly in order to successfully meet the project needs. In between growth status meetings, provide a status/pipeline update at least once on all in-progress tickets until closure.
  • Product quality & results: Ensures a QA rework rate of 5% of deliverables, post-live rate of 2-3 issues per sprint within the entire book of business.
    • How they get there: As a result of their management/ coordination, they are able to meet the needs of the project in a timely and successful manner.
  • Client Satisfaction: Achieve an average client satisfaction score of 4.5 out of 5 on feedback surveys within the first 3 and 6 months with the client.
    • How they get there: Ensure clients are satisfied with conversion rate optimization efforts and overall service by improving client feedback and satisfaction levels. This will be accomplished by regularly communicating progress, proactively addressing client needs, and resolving any concerns that arise.
  • Client Escalation: Ensure client escalations are resolved and churn is avoided by maintaining 95% escalations closed with the client retained and active 60 days post resolution, proactively and accurately logging 100% of escalations on a weekly basis in the CS Sentiment Sheet
    • How they get there: Partnering with the escalation lead assigned to define an action plan and providing at least two updates per week to clients and CS team until closure.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Assertive Communication: Maintain clear communication with our internal and external teams. Drive agendas, notes, status, and next steps aligning timelines, scope, and outcomes.
  • Client Retention: Maintain monthly recurring revenue retention & prevent churn risks.
  • Technology Utilization (AI & Tools): Leverage AI and internal tools to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Coordinate design/dev/AD seamlessly with crisp handoffs and clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactive Ownership: Anticipate needs, identify risks early, and take action before issues arise.
  • Resource Planning & Allocation: Understand pod capacity and capabilities end-to-end; build realistic weekly plans; proactively re-prioritize and reassign as needs change to maintain service quality and hit deadlines.
  • Operational Excellence: Impeccable attention to detail, organization, and documentation, own the project lifecycle with clear acceptance criteria, thorough QC, and on-time deliverables.
  • Strategy & Execution Balance: Balance strategic thinking with high-quality execution, ensuring ideas translate into measurable impact.

Role Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communication, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus
  • 1-3+ years of experience in account management within a marketing agency environment
  • Strong knowledge of marketing strategies, digital marketing, and advertising concepts.
  • Proficiency in using project management and collaboration tools such as Clickup, Basecamp, and Asana
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Leadership experience with the ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies, such as Scrum, and the ability to adapt to changing project requirements
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and strategically
  • Proven ability to manage multiple clients at once while maintaining quality and responsiveness
  • Experience or familiarity with AI tools to improve workflows and productivity is a plus
  • Strong client-facing skills, including the ability to build and maintain relationships
  • English proficiency: B2 minimum

Website Analytics InternVulcury Venture Studio and Advisors · Remote · Duration - 12 weeks, Stipend: 8k -16k About VulcuryVulcury is a California–based venture studio that builds and operates companies alongside its portfolio, including Trustbridge Design & Manufacturing and Calisade Asset Management.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Website Analytics Intern

Vulcury Venture Studio and Advisors · Remote · Duration - 12 weeks, Stipend: 8k -16k

About Vulcury

Vulcury is a California–based venture studio that builds and operates companies alongside its portfolio, including Trustbridge Design & Manufacturing and Calisade Asset Management. Our team is small and fully remote, so interns get real ownership and work directly with the people making decisions.

The role
We run multiple websites across the studio and portfolio, and we need someone who can turn traffic data into clear answers: where visitors come from, what they do, where they drop off, and what we should change. You'll own tracking setup, reporting, and insight for these sites, and your recommendations will go straight to leadership.

What you'll do

  • Audit and maintain GA4 and Google Tag Manager setups across Vulcury and portfolio sites, fixing broken or missing events, conversions, and UTM conventions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio or similar) that leadership can read in under two minutes.
  • Track key funnels (contact forms, demo requests, careers page, newsletter signups) and flag drop-off points.
  • Use Google Search Console and heatmap/session tools (Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or similar) to diagnose page-level issues.
  • Produce a weekly performance summary: what changed, why, and what to do next.
  • Partner with the content, social, and growth teams to set up tracking for new pages and campaigns, and measure their impact.

What we're looking for

  • Final-year student or recent graduate (within ~12 months) in marketing, CS, statistics, or economics are a plus, but not required.
  • Hands-on GA4 experience on a real, live website (your own site, a client, a college club, a startup), not only course certifications.
  • Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager: you've created tags, triggers, and variables yourself.
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (pivots, lookups); basic SQL or Python is a bonus.
  • Able to explain a chart to a non-technical founder in plain English.
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote, async setup.

Nice to have

  • Looker Studio dashboards you can show us
  • Familiarity with Zoho tools (Zoho Analytics, PageSense, or CRM)
  • Experience with A/B testing or CRO
How to apply
Send your resume plus one example of analytics work, such as a dashboard link, screenshot, or short write-up of a website insight you found and what it led to. Applications with a work sample will be reviewed fir

jobs.excerpt: Project/Client: Banking Location: Baltic states and Poland (Remote) Start Date: ASAP Rate: 30 -38 EUR per hour Language: English (B2+) Role Overview: We are looking for a skilled iOS Developer to join a team working on a native banking application.
jobs.description:
Project/Client: Banking
Location: Baltic states and Poland (Remote)
Start Date: ASAP
Rate: 30 -38 EUR per hour
Language: English (B2+)

Role Overview:
We are looking for a skilled iOS Developer to join a team working on a native banking application. The role involves building and maintaining features within a highly modularized multi-module architecture using Swift and SwiftUI, following MVVM, RIB, and Clean Architecture principles. The developer will work with RESTful APIs, implement reactive patterns via Combine and Swift Concurrency, and contribute to security-focused modules including authentication, biometrics, and cryptographic signing. Collaboration across teams, code quality, and ownership mindset are key expectations for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a native iOS banking application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Work with RESTful APIs, networking, and JSON data formats via a modular networking layer.
  • Build features within a highly modularized multi-module architecture (Tuist, Swift Package Manager) following RIB, MVVM, and Clean Architecture principles.
  • Implement reactive and asynchronous patterns using Combine and Swift Concurrency (async/await).
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards of performance, security, and user experience — including work on authentication, biometrics, device integrity, fraud checks, and cryptographic signing modules.
  • Write and maintain unit tests (SwiftTest) and use generated mocks/test-support frameworks per module.
  • Maintain high code quality, perform knowledge sharing, and take end-to-end ownership of delivered solutions.
  • Collaborate using Git and contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane).

Must-Have Requirements:

  • Proven experience in native iOS application development.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift; hands-on experience with SwiftUI (UIKit knowledge is a plus).
  • Experience with Combine and/or Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors).
  • Strong understanding of MVVM and Clean Architecture; experience working in large, modularized codebases (Tuist, Swift Package Manager, or similar).
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, handling JSON, and working with URLSession-based networking.
  • Understanding of dependency injection patterns and modularization principles.
  • Experience with unit testing (SwiftTest) and mocking/test-support tooling.
  • Version control proficiency with Git.
  • Good command of English (minimum B2).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane).
  • Knowledge of cryptography and secure coding practices (e.g. asymmetric cryptography, secure signing, biometric authentication).
  • Familiarity with OWASP MASVS (Mobile Application Security Verification Standard).
  • Experience with Apple Wallet / PassKit extensions.
  • Experience with code generation/templating tools (e.g. Sourcery-style mock generation).

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Principal, IT Strategy & Operations Manager is a senior individual-contributor role that partners with Technology VPs, Finance, business leaders, and external partners to shape IT strategy, translate technology investments into business value, and drive disciplined execution. The role combines strategic planning with hands-on ownership of cloud program financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, governance, and executive reporting.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • IT strategy and business value: Partner with VPs to define transformation priorities, future-state capabilities, roadmaps, and investment choices. Identify how IT can improve customer outcomes, operational performance, and top-line growth, and translate recommendations into clear business cases and measurable outcomes.
  • AI and operational efficiency: Identify and advance practical AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and increase productivity across the organization.
  • Financial planning and governance: Manage cloud-program budgets, forecasts, milestones, funding requests, business cases, and actuals. Maintain alignment with Lumen Transformation Office, Finance, corporate planning, and Long-Term Outlook requirements, and provide clear variance explanations and decision support.
  • Professional services and forecasting: Coordinate professional-services funding requests and governance reviews, guide teams through procurement, maintain contract-level capital and expense forecasts, post monthly actuals, and prepare reporting for Cloud Program leadership.
  • Executive & Organizational Operations: Maintain dashboards, scorecards, leadership decks, and portfolio reporting.
  • Lead cross-functional follow-through on priorities, risks, dependencies, and actions while continuously improving financial controls and operating processes.
  • Cloud budget management as needed by providing support on monthly accruals; reconcile cloud-management data, provider invoices, actuals, and minimum commitments; maintain commitment-attainment reporting; validate dashboards; and provide detailed cloud-spend analysis across AWS, Microsoft, and Google.

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in IT strategy, technology finance, business operations, consulting, transformation, or related disciplines.

deine herausforderung bei uns

Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für fachliche, technische und regulatorische Anforderungen der Software und stellst sicher, dass Änderungen, Fehlerbehebungen und Weiterentwicklungen strukturiert priorisiert, umgesetzt, getestet und in den stabilen Betrieb überführt werden. Damit leistest Du einen wichtigen Beitrag zu unserem Smart-Meter-Rollout und Messstellenbetrieb und schaffst die Grundlage für innovative Energiekonzepte wie Mieterstrom, Energy Sharing, dynamische Stromtarife und intelligentes Energiemanagement.

  • Du steuerst die Systempflege und Konfiguration der MaKo-Software, z.B. eNet-Daten-Updates, Versandabonnements und weitere Services.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachteams Anforderungen für neue Funktionalitäten, Automatisierungen und notwendige Systemanpassungen.
  • Du bewertest regulatorische Änderungen hinsichtlich ihrer Auswirkungen auf die MaKo-Software und steuerst die notwendige Umsetzung.
  • Du koordinierst Releases, Patches und Hotfixes und stellst durch strukturiertes Testing sicher, dass bestehende Prozesse, Schnittstellen und Customizings weiterhin funktionieren.
  • Du sorgst für Transparenz zu Betriebskosten, Angeboten sowie externen und internen Aufwänden und verantwortest das entsprechende Reporting.
  • Du entwickelst Dich zum zentralen fachlichen Experten für unser MaKo-Software und unterstützt die operativen Teams bei komplexen Fragestellungen.

das bringst du mit

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis der energiewirtschaftlichen Marktkommunikation und der Prozesse eines Messstellenbetreibers.
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in klare Systemanforderungen, Testfälle und Abnahmekriterien zu übersetzen.
  • Erfahrung mit Bugtracking, Customer Requests, Releases, Testing und fachlicher Abnahme.
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister sowie im Kosten- und Aufwandscontrolling.
  • Fundiertes regulatorisches Wissen, insbesondere zu WiM, GPKE, MaBiS und relevanten EDIFACT-Prozessen.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse energiewirtschaftlicher Marktkommunikationssysteme, idealerweise Robotron eCount.
  • Strukturierte, verbindliche und kommunikative Arbeitsweise an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachteams, IT und Dienstleistern.

das bieten wir dir

  • 100 % Remote möglich – Du entscheidest, ob Du im Büro Saarlouis, Mannheim oder von Zuhause arbeitest.
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen im Herzen der Energiewende.
  • Ein dynamisches Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents - Lerne deine Kolleg:innen auch privat kennen!
  • Zusätzlicher Urlaub bei Geburten und der eigenen Hochzeit.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge - wir unterstützen dich!

About the Role

We are raising the bar for Senior Accountants. We are not just looking for technical skills. We need confident, experienced professionals who can lead teams, work directly with U.S.-based clients, and drive continuous improvement in processes and systems.

This is a client-facing leadership role that demands exceptional attention to detail, proactive communication, and strong relationship management. You will manage people, oversee deliverables, and bring innovative ideas to the table, especially around automation and AI-driven efficiency. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, lead by example, and take pride in precision, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment Process

We aim to complete the recruitment process within seven to ten calendar days. We are looking for exceptional leaders with outstanding communication skills, a meticulous eye for detail, and a proven ability to manage clients and teams.

  • Initial Interview (30–45 min) : A conversation to get to know you, your background, and your motivation for joining VargasAndrews.
  • Pre-Requisite : Submission of a sample work or accounting portfolio.
  • Behavioral Interview (60–90 min) : An in-depth discussion using real-life scenarios to assess communication, leadership style, client management, and your approach to innovation and problem-solving.
  • Technical Interview (60–90 min): A rigorous evaluation of your technical expertise, client relationship experience, and your ability to leverage modern tools and AI to drive process improvements.
  • Pre-Engagement : Reference Check and IT Audit.

Company Overview

VargasAndrews is an international professional services firm specializing in business transformations and turnarounds. We exist to transform lives — and we live that mission every single day, not just on a poster.

We believe in:

  • Teamwork & Camaraderie
  • Hiring & Developing the Best
  • Agility & Lean Thinking
  • Customer Obsession
  • Curiosity & Systemization
  • Ownership & Accountability

We are a why organization, not a what organization. It is not what we do, but why we do it that drives us every day. Our vision is to become an international market leader in business transformations.

Visit our website and connect with us on LinkedIn to learn more.

Why Join Us?

Working for VargasAndrews means joining a global workforce of passionate, motivated A-players. We believe in hiring driven individuals and supporting them with direction and resources. We work smart, not just hard.

  • Work with a Global Team of A-Players
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits
  • A Dynamic, Digital-First Workplace
  • U.S.-Facing Roles with Real Impact and Growth

Scope of Services

The following outlines the primary service areas and KPIs for the Senior Accountant I, as defined in our RCFO engagement framework:

Engagement & Client Management

  • Lead and act as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing inquiries, concerns, and requests promptly and effectively.
  • Facilitate meetings, presentations, and discussions to deepen client understanding and satisfaction.
  • Monitor client satisfaction and feedback, taking proactive measures to address issues and enhance the overall client experience.
  • Create detailed client project plans, timelines, and schedules to ensure timely completion of all deliverables.
  • Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members, providing guidance and support as needed.
  • Conduct regular project meetings to review status, discuss challenges, and make necessary adjustments.

Senior Accounting Work

Accounts Receivable

  • Reconciliation of customer invoices with the accounting system and bank payments/deposits received.
  • Preparation and submission of monthly invoices to clients no later than the agreed deadline (as applicable).
  • Ensure customer payments are recorded at most 1 day from receipt of payment.
  • Consistent monitoring and follow-through of customer payments, especially invoices more than 30 days past due.
  • Ensure that AR Aging reports are delivered to clients on a weekly basis and that escalation SOPs are followed as required.

Bank Reconciliation

  • Daily checking of the bank statement and daily recording of bank transactions in the client's accounting system.
  • Reconcile bank statement to book statement at most 2 days from the previous month-end.

Accounts Payable

  • Ensure all payments are properly approved and substantiated with supporting documents.
  • Ensure all Purchase Orders are duly approved by the Board.
  • Send AP Aging Report with notes for important payables.
  • Weekly monitoring of AP Aging and prompt reporting of any inconsistencies or new transactions to the Fractional Controller.

Payments to Employees & Contractors

  • Prepare the manual Pay Report on salaries and fees paid to employees and contractors within at most 2 days from the end of the payment cut-off period.
  • Record detailed payroll expenses no later than 2 days after the end of the payment period, with journal entries referencing the Pay Report.
  • Record payments to employees and contractors no later than 2 days from the payment period.

General Accounts

  • Accrue revenues and expenses for the month as needed.
  • Reverse accrued revenues and expenses for the month as needed.
  • Record prepayments and adjust as needed.
  • Review, record, and adjust other accounts as needed.

Financial Statement Closing Process

  • Prepare financial statements, financial statement consolidation, and variance and trend analysis reports in coordination with the Fractional Controller.
  • Ensure the completeness of accruals at most 3 days following the month to be closed.
  • Aid in the preparation of data to compute and present monthly budgets and forecasts required by the Client.
  • Review and reconcile balance sheet accounts on or before the 2nd Monday of the following month.

Policies & Procedures

  • Design and implement processes and procedures to improve the accounting processes of the Client and its related entities.

Other Required Tasks

  • Other related tasks that may be assigned by the SLT, Chief Financial Officer, and/or Fractional Controller, as communicated to the Contractor.

Essential Functions

  • 40% Senior accounting work — manage the full accounting cycle (Order to Cash, Procurement to Pay, Record to Report), financial reporting, budget preparation, variance analysis, payroll oversight, and complex reconciliations across multiple client accounts.
  • 30% Client engagement and team leadership — act as primary client point of contact, lead team task distribution, conduct review meetings, and ensure delivery quality and on-time completion.
  • 20% Review, quality control, and mentoring — review and approve work of Junior and Intermediate Accountants, conduct onboarding and training of new hires, and support recruitment activities.
  • 10% Process improvement and innovation — design and implement accounting SOPs, drive automation and AI-tool adoption, and coordinate strategic improvement initiatives with the Fractional Controller.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting
  • Certification: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) — Required.
  • Certified Management Accountant (CMA) is an advantage.
  • Experience: 5 to 7 years as a Senior Accountant or in a similar leadership role, preferably in an outsourced or international setup
  • Solid knowledge of US GAAP, IFRS, tax laws, and reporting standards
  • Excellent English communication skills — verbal and written — with the ability to confidently manage client relationships and explain complex concepts clearly
  • Exceptional leadership skills: able to inspire and guide teams while maintaining accountability and high standards
  • A sharp eye for detail and a structured, meticulous approach to problem-solving and reviewing work
  • Proven ability to manage tight deadlines, multiple priorities, and team workloads in a high-pressure environment
  • Experience in cost accounting is a plus
  • Experience using AI-driven tools or systems is highly desirable
  • Must be amenable to working on a U.S. Pacific Time schedule, with the possibility of a full night shift (see Working Schedule section)

Tools & Systems

  • Required: QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel (advanced proficiency)
  • Preferred: Xero, Bill.com or similar AP platforms
  • Advantage: ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage, or similar), AI and automation tools

Additional Role Requirements

  • Client Engagement - This role works directly with U.S.-based clients. It requires strong communication skills, professionalism, clarity, and the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across borders.
  • Innovation & AI Focus We seek individuals who are highly innovative and driven to leverage AI tools and technology to enhance processes, improve accuracy, and deliver value-added insights to clients.

Leadership Skills

  • Outstanding leadership skills are essential. We are looking for proactive professionals who can inspire teams, maintain rigorous attention to detail, and ensure client satisfaction through exemplary management and communication.

Service Fee & Benefits

  • $1,700 – $2,200 / month All-In | Independent Contractor | Level-Banded The final offer is determined at the conclusion of the full interview process, based on qualifications and demonstrated experience:
    • $1,700/month — Senior Accountant Level 1
    • $1,700 – $1,900/month — Senior Accountant Level 2
    • $1,900 – $2,200/month — Senior Accountant Level 3

Benefits Package

  • Service-Break Credits (SBC) — Up to 120 Hours/Year : Use your SBC for personal time, rest days, or unexpected emergencies — at your own discretion. We believe rest is part of performing at your best.
  • U.S. Observance Day Credits — 13 Days/Year : You earn SBC credits on 13 recognized U.S. observance days, giving you built-in breathing room throughout the year without touching your regular credits.
  • Monthly Health Allowance — Starting Month 7 : After your 6th month of continuous engagement, you receive a monthly health allowance to support your personal wellness and preventive care
  • Dependent Health Allowance : After a period of continuous engagement, you unlock an annual dependent wellness allowance — because your family's wellbeing matters too.
  • Work From Anywhere in the Philippines : Fully remote. No commute. Work from home, a co-working space, or wherever you are most productive — anywhere in the Philippines with a reliable connection.

Working Schedule & Time Zone

Important: U.S. Client Alignment

Our clients are based in the United States. Our standard operating window is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) / Pacific Daylight Time (PDT). In practice, the majority of our team currently works a shift of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time, allowing for focused mornings before live client hours begin. Working schedule is ultimately subject to client discretion. Some clients may require a full night shift alignment (Philippine Time). We want every candidate to enter with full awareness of this expectation.

jobs.excerpt: Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT.
jobs.description:
Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT. We are a global digital engineering, product development, and technology consulting company. Headquartered in New York, we have a team of 1000+ experts working across 65+ countries.

About this job:

We are seeking a hands-on platform engineer to architect and build the self-service capabilities our development teams need for their work on Databricks. The goal is that those teams provision their own data, infrastructure, and applications through governed, automated paths instead of filing tickets with the platform team. Platform engineering is a new discipline here, so the role spans defining the approach, building it, and training our team to carry it forward after the engagement ends.

Location: Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay, Chile, Canada (remote)

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead the build of the developer self-service capabilities — bundle templates, provisioning scripts, and onboarding documentation that let domain teams stand up catalogs, schemas, service principals, and Lakebase databases themselves, replacing the current pattern of individually filed, often duplicated manual infrastructure tickets;
  • Lead governance-as-code end to end — designing policy, building the validator/resolver engine, and extending enforcement to provisioning paths not currently covered (e.g., catalog-level grants declared in Terraform, which today bypass the same anti-escalation controls applied everywhere else);
  • CI/CD deployment platform standardization — own the CI/CD deployment platform: bring reusable workflows and composite actions in-house, complete the move to OIDC federation so deploys carry no stored credentials, and hold all domain repos on a single policy version;
  • Design least-privilege automation — scoped bot/service credentials with explicit, tested boundaries rather than broad standing access;
  • Upskill the team currently covering this work — provide hands-on mentorship and pair with staff who are performing manual, UI-driven infrastructure administration today, moving them toward Infrastructure as Code and self-service patterns through direct collaboration, documentation, and internal training;
  • Evaluate and pilot new platform capabilities — assess newer Databricks platform features (e.g., native secrets management) in a controlled pilot before broader adoption;
  • Maintain platform documentation and migration tooling — getting-started guides and retrofit/migration scripts for legacy repositories so onboarding a new domain does not require hand-holding from the platform team.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field;
  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Big Data roles;
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks;
  • Experience in the insurance industry;
  • Strong knowledge of the AWS cloud platform;
  • Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted development tools.

Core platform skills:

  • Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) authoring — designing reusable, parameterized bundle templates that let domain teams scaffold new projects rather than hand-building them;
  • Governance-as-code — machine-readable policy design (classification-driven grant matrices, role/binding resolution), paired with a static pre-deploy validator and deploy-time enforcement, so access rules are enforced automatically rather than reviewed manually;
  • Unity Catalog access model design — least-privilege, tiered access (admin/develop/read) with environment- and classification-aware enforcement, including closing gaps where infrastructure-as-code paths (e.g., Terraform-declared catalog grants) fall outside existing governance coverage;
  • Infrastructure as Code — Terraform for platform-level resources (catalogs, workspace infrastructure) alongside Databricks Asset Bundles for domain-level resources;
  • CI/CD platform engineering — GitHub Actions at scale, including building and owning reusable workflows and composite actions, implementing OIDC federation to replace stored credentials, and keeping many domain repositories on one shared workflow and policy version;
  • OLTP/Lakebase provisioning — end-to-end lifecycle management (service principals, schema-level read/write roles, Data API enablement) exposed as a self-service workflow instead of one-off manual setup;
  • Automation and tooling development — Python CLI tooling, validators, and test suites; least-privilege automation design (scoped bot credentials, smoke-tested boundaries) instead of standing broad access;
  • Compute governance — cluster policies and Databricks Runtime version planning/rollout across dev/QA/prod, standardizing configurations instead of per-team ad hoc setup.

Other skills:

  • English — excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Ability to work in a global, multinational company;
  • Ability to lead conversations with both technical and business representatives;
  • Proven ability to work both independently and as part of an international project team.

If you're looking to contribute to global projects, grow your skills, shape the way you work, and be part of a connected international community — Customertimes is the place to build your next career chapter. Are you ready to spark the tech with us?

to make more informed decisions about their health. We break down barriers, myths, and taboos. Our workplace is agile, diverse, and full of opportunities for growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a Freelance Community Moderator for a project-based engagement to help us scale and establish our new Clue Community feature, keeping it safe, kind and true to what it’s for.

Clue Community is an anonymous, in-app space where people can connect with others who understand and support them. It's peer support: members do most of the talking, answering and reassuring. The job is to make that possible and keep it safe. Some days that means stepping in. Most days it means knowing when to stay out.

The community covers some of the most emotionally loaded health experiences there are, including years long struggles before getting diagnosed, loss and fertility treatment. You'll read hard posts, make careful calls and write replies that sound like a real person, not a brand.

Project scope

Moderation and safety

  • Check the community and review flagged posts and comments, and act in line with the and guidelines.
  • Decide when to stay out, comment, move a post to the right group, remove content or ban a member, and always give members a clear reason.
  • Protect anonymity: remove anything that could identify a member or someone else, and escalate possible GDPR issues.
  • Keep clinical advice and unverified health claims out of the community, including in members' replies.
  • Follow the crisis protocol when a member may be at risk: leave the post up, escalate straight away and post the approved reply once.
  • Escalate unclear cases, appeals and threats
  • Log every removal, ban and monitoring decision in the shared moderation sheet.

Member replies

  • Understand and follow the community guidelines when moderating the forum.
  • Write replies in Clue's voice when a moderator comment is the right call.
  • Point any questions to Customer Support or other teams when needed
  • Pass feedback to the Product team and Science team.
  • Sharing the collected learnings and observations for further development of the feature.

What you bring

  • Some experience moderating or supporting an online community, forum or social channel. Volunteer experience counts.
  • Excellent written English. You can say something kind and clear in three short sentences.
  • Additional languages are a plus, especially Spanish and/or Portuguese.
  • Calm, steady judgement on sensitive topics. You can read a hard post, act on it and step back.
  • Discretion and a strong sense of privacy. You understand why anonymity matters in a reproductive health space.
  • Comfort following a guide closely, and the confidence to flag when a case doesn't fit it.
  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can support careful, human work.
  • Organised and reliable. You log decisions, keep to a daily rhythm and follow through.

Nice to have

  • Interest in reproductive health or women's health.
  • Basic knowledge of GDPR or the EU Digital Services Act.
  • Mental health first aid or crisis-awareness training. If you don't have it yet, we'll support you to get it.
  • Experience with Slack, Google Sheets or community platforms.

Good to know

  • Location: Remote
  • Contract: Freelance, up to 20 hours per week
  • Reporting to: Director of Customer Success and Operations
  • Support: this role involves reading distressing content. You'll get crisis-protocol onboarding, a clear escalation path and regular check-ins with your manager.

Note

We encourage applications even if you do not meet every requirement. We are looking for potential and impact, not perfection.

Customer Activation Specialist (Temporary Contract)

Full-Time Temporary Contract | Remote

About Societ

Societ is a leading software company dedicated to empowering nonprofit organizations. Our solutions support case management, donor management, fundraising, and financial processing, helping nonprofits focus on what matters most: their mission.

As we grow Glass Register, our free online donation platform, we're looking for a resourceful, customer-facing professional to help nonprofit organizations move successfully from sign-up to active fundraising.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an organized, resourceful, high-energy self-starter who takes pride in helping nonprofits move from “We signed up” to “We’re successfully fundraising.” As a Customer Activation Specialist, you will own the early customer journey for qualified organizations, from eligibility review through setup and early fundraising. You'll be expected to notice when organizations stall, take initiative to re-engage them, and work toward clear activation and service goals.

Most organizations will begin their fundraising journey through Glass Register’s self-serve sign-up process. When needed, you will respond to inbound requests and provide one-to-one walkthroughs to help organizations decide whether Glass Register is a fit, complete setup, and go live.

What You’ll Do

  • Review new Glass Register accounts and inbound inquiries, using established processes to verify that organizations are legitimate nonprofit or charitable organizations eligible to use Glass Register.
  • Maintain complete and accurate customer, verification, task, and follow-up records in Glass Register and the CRM.
  • Proactively contact qualified organizations by phone, Zoom, and email when they stall after sign-up. Use sound judgment, persistence, and creative problem-solving to help them move forward and improve the conversion of qualified inbound organizations into active fundraisers.
  • Help organizations complete setup and start fundraising, including Stripe connection, donation forms and campaigns. Provide practical support by email, phone or Zoom, including demos and onboarding sessions when helpful.
  • Respond to inbound questions from prospective and existing customers, resolving routine account, payment and product questions independently and escalating complex technical issues when needed.
  • Identify where organizations commonly stall after signing up and recommend improvements to follow-up, guidance, resources, and the self-serve journey. Share recurring questions, friction points, and fundraising-related feedback with the Product team to help more qualified organizations launch and fundraise successfully.

What We’re Looking For

We care more about your curiosity, drive, and ability to learn than a perfect background. You may be early in your career. If you are eager to learn, organized, comfortable with technology, and willing to take ownership, we encourage you to apply.

The right candidate has:

  • Experience in a customer-facing, sales, support, onboarding, fundraising, or operations role is an asset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence supporting customers and presenting the product by phone or video.
  • Excellent organization, follow-through, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment when reviewing organizations, customer needs, and eligibility requirements.
  • The ability to learn new software tools quickly and explain a product clearly to customers with different levels of technical confidence.
  • A practical, solutions-oriented approach to researching unfamiliar problems, taking initiative, and knowing when to escalate.
  • Motivation to work toward measurable goals, take ownership of outcomes, and follow through when an organization needs support to move forward.

Bonus Experience

  • Nonprofit, charity, or fundraising experience.
  • SaaS, fundraising technology, or payment-platform experience, particularly Stripe.
  • CRM experience, particularly Zoho CRM.

Success in This Role

After six months, you will have:

  • Completed eligibility reviews promptly and consistently, ensuring qualified organizations receive timely follow-up.
  • Helped qualified organizations complete setup, publish donation forms or campaigns, and become active fundraisers with Glass Register.
  • Maintained an accurate customer funnel in Zoho CRM, giving leadership visibility into customer progress and blockers.
  • Met agreed inbound service and conversion goals, including timely responses and meaningful customer progress from sign-up through early fundraising.
  • Identified high-value onboarding friction points and shared customer feedback with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to improve the self-serve experience.

Why This Opportunity?

Glass Register provides eligible nonprofit and charitable organizations with a fast, simple, and completely free way to fundraise online while keeping 100% of every gift. Your work will help organizations move smoothly from sign-up to a live donation form to receiving their first donations, removing cost and technical barriers so more of the money they raise can go directly toward the communities and causes they serve. This is varied, hands-on work that combines customer interaction, problem-solving, fundraising and technology.

Engagement Details

  • Full-time, remote temporary contract.
  • Target annual compensation: $50,000 to $60,000.
  • Expected through December 2027, with the opportunity for extension based on performance and company need.
  • We are actively interviewing and looking to hire as soon as possible.
Salary: $50,000-$60,000

You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

  • Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it
  • Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops
  • Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering
  • Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)
  • Equip CSMs and Technical Support with the knowledge to handle deliverability conversations, through coaching, documentation, and training
  • Improve processes, tools, and one-to-many resources, such as help content, Academy course and proactive customer guidance, so deliverability support scales across the organization

  • Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering
  • Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations
  • Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them
  • Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience
  • Located in the United States or Canada
  • Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected.

We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Regional Logistics Manager – Radar System Replacement (RSR)

Position Summary

The Regional Logistics Manager coordinates logistics support for RSR sites within an assigned region, helping ensure equipment, services, and materials are available when needed to support radar removal, installation, testing, and return to service. The manager works closely with FAA personnel, Peraton regional managers and site representatives, radar vendors, subcontractors, and local service providers to maintain site readiness and resolve logistics issues.

This position also coordinates with radar vendors to track equipment movement, confirm delivery schedules, and identify transportation or material delays that could affect site execution.

Position Location:Remote (Some travel to RSR sites may be required)

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate site logistics and readiness. Identify each site’s logistics requirements before work begins and maintain a checklist of required services, equipment, delivery dates, and responsible parties.
  • Help sites acquire equipment and services. Arrange dumpsters, portable toilets, forklifts, cranes, material-handling equipment, temporary storage, and other items needed for site preparation, removal, installation, and cleanup.
  • Coordinate purchasing and funding approvals. Obtain quotes, prepare purchase or rental requests, and work with authorized procurement and program personnel to secure approvals. Track commitments against approved site budgets.
  • Track vendor equipment movement. Work with vendors and transportation providers to monitor radar equipment, installation materials, replacement components, and spare parts from shipment through site receipt. Maintain visibility into shipment status, expected arrival dates, delivery changes, and receiving requirements.
  • Coordinate deliveries and receiving. Confirm site access, delivery windows, unloading arrangements, storage space, and availability of personnel and equipment to receive shipments. Verify delivery documentation and coordinate resolution of shortages, damage, or incorrect shipments.
  • Support equipment removal and disposition. Coordinate packaging, loading, transportation, temporary storage, and approved disposition of removed equipment and materials in accordance with FAA direction and contractual requirements.
  • Manage rental and service schedules. Coordinate delivery, servicing, extensions, pickup, and closeout of rented equipment and temporary site services to support the installation schedule and control costs.
  • Maintain logistics records and accountability. Track rental equipment, shipments, receipts, service orders, costs, and outstanding requirements. Clearly identify ownership and responsibility for government, vendor, and Peraton equipment.
  • Resolve and escalate logistics issues. Address missed deliveries, equipment shortages, transportation constraints, and service-provider problems. Elevate issues that threaten site readiness or schedule milestones and recommend recovery actions.
  • Report regional logistics status. Provide routine updates on site readiness, equipment movement, upcoming deliveries, costs, and unresolved issues. Coordinate logistics activities with the Integrated Master Schedule and daily site reporting.
  • Support safe site operations. Coordinate appropriate equipment capacity, qualified operators, and required access arrangements with responsible site personnel. Ensure logistics plans account for site conditions and applicable safety requirements.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain/maintain required Public Trust clearance.
  • A minimum of 8 years of expeirence with a Bachelor's degree; 6 years with a Master's; a total of 12 years without a degree.
  • Experience coordinating logistics, transportation, procurement support, or field operations for geographically dispersed projects.
  • Experience arranging equipment rentals, temporary site services, freight deliveries, and material handling.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple sites and competing priorities while maintaining accurate schedules and records.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and tools used to track shipments, costs, inventory, and schedules.
  • Ability to work effectively with government personnel, vendors, subcontractors, and local service providers.
  • Ability to travel within the assigned region and meet applicable FAA facility access requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting radar, aviation, telecommunications, construction, or other technical infrastructure deployments.
  • Familiarity with FAA field operations, remote-site logistics, and government property accountability.
  • Experience supporting equipment removal, disposition, and installation activities.
  • Familiarity with integrated schedules, site-readiness reviews, and logistics risk management.

Measures of Success

  • Required site services and equipment are available before scheduled work begins.
  • Vendor shipments and equipment movements are accurately tracked and communicated.
  • Logistics issues are identified early and resolved before they affect critical milestones.
  • Site expenditures remain within approved funding, and rentals are closed promptly.
  • Delivery, receipt, and disposition records are complete and accurate.

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Oracle Consulting & Professional Services

Position Level: Executive Leadership

Business Scope: $300M+ Global Professional Services Organization

Position Overview

The Chief Delivery Officer (CDO) / Global Delivery Leader is responsible for the strategic direction, operational performance, financial results, and overall execution of a global Oracle consulting and professional services organization generating $300+ million or more in annual revenue.

This executive leads a geographically distributed organization delivering complex Oracle Cloud SaaS, Oracle Technology, and enterprise transformation programs for large and multinational clients. The successful candidate has progressed from hands-on Oracle project delivery through program, portfolio, and executive leadership roles.

The role combines Oracle ecosystem expertise, large-scale P&L management, global delivery operations, executive client engagement, and the ability to translate business strategy into measurable operational results. A central mandate is embedding AI, automation, standardized methodologies, and innovative delivery models to improve productivity, quality, scalability, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Global Delivery Strategy & Executive Leadership

  • Define and execute global delivery strategy aligned with growth, financial commitments, and Oracle practice priorities.
  • Lead a $300M+ global services organization across geographies, industries, and service lines.
  • Establish a scalable onshore, nearshore, and offshore operating model.
  • Translate enterprise strategy into delivery plans, operating priorities, and measurable results.
  • Build capabilities supporting growth, service expansion, acquisitions, and changing market demands.
  • Develop a high-performing global leadership team with clear financial, operational, and client accountability.
  • Partner with Sales, Practice Leadership, Finance, HR, and executive management to align commitments and execution.

P&L Ownership & Financial Performance

  • Own revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, operating expenses, profitability, and delivery-related financial commitments for a $300M+ business.
  • Establish financial governance and deliver revenue and profitability objectives.
  • Optimize utilization, realization, billable capacity, resource productivity, and delivery costs.
  • Oversee forecasting, backlog conversion, project financial performance, and resource demand planning.

  • Improve margins through delivery efficiency, global leverage, workforce optimization, and automation.

Oracle SaaS & Technology Delivery Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight for Oracle implementations, modernization, and enterprise transformation programs.
  • Apply progressive experience from project execution through increasingly complex delivery leadership roles.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, SCM, EPM, and CX applications.
  • Understand OCI, integration platforms, databases, analytics, and application modernization.
  • Oversee multi-workstream programs involving architecture, integration, data migration, change management, and process redesign.
  • Set quality controls and governance across Oracle SaaS and Technology practices.
  • Sponsor high-risk engagements, lead escalations, and remain informed of Oracle product roadmaps.

Global Delivery Model & Resource Management

  • Design and optimize globally integrated onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery capabilities.
  • Clarify accountability across regional leaders, global capability centers, practices, and shared services.
  • Balance cost competitiveness, skills availability, quality, and client requirements in workforce strategy.
  • Lead resource management, capacity planning, staffing, subcontractor utilization, and productivity.
  • Standardize global staffing, utilization, skills development, and performance management processes.
  • Maintain flexibility for regional, industry, and client requirements while promoting cross-border collaboration.

Executive Client Management & Delivery Excellence

  • Lead steering committees, program reviews, contract-related discussions, and critical escalations.
  • Deliver commitments for scope, schedule, quality, business outcomes, and financial performance.
  • Partner with Sales and account leadership on retention, expansion, and long-term client relationships.
  • Measure client satisfaction and account health; personally lead recovery of challenged programs.

Delivery Methodology, Governance & Quality

  • Institutionalize a consistent, scalable delivery methodology across Oracle professional services.
  • Apply and drive Oracle Cloud implementation Methodologies, waterfall, Hybrid Waterfall Agile methods as appropriate.
  • Establish governance for initiation, planning, execution, risk, quality assurance, and closure.
  • Use project health reviews, executive dashboards, stage gates, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Control scope, changes, project economics, and contractual commitments.
  • Promote reusable assets, accelerators, templates, tools, and lessons learned to improve predictability.

AI Strategy, Transformation & Delivery Innovation

  • Develop and execute a strategy for embedding AI throughout the professional services delivery lifecycle.
  • Implement AI-enabled delivery to improve productivity, speed, quality, and margins.
  • Prioritize use cases in requirements, solution design, configuration, development, testing, data migration, documentation, and project management.

Internal Operations & Organizational Management

Required Qualifications & Experience

Professional Experience

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Job Summary

The Director, Collections provides strategic leadership and enterprise-level oversight for Ziply Fiber’s collections function, with responsibility for developing and executing collection strategies, operating practices, and performance measures that minimize financial loss, reduce delinquency, protect revenue, and support long-term business objectives. This role leads complex analysis of account, payment, billing, and dispute trends; identifies operational, financial, compliance, and customer experience risks; and drives cross-functional initiatives that improve collection effectiveness, strengthen internal controls, and support scalable business growth.

The Director partners with senior leaders across Commercial, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, Operations, and external partners to resolve complex issues, guide risk-based decision-making, and ensure collection practices align with company goals, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and a positive customer experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Collections Strategy, Analytics, and Process Improvement

·Design and execute comprehensive collection strategies aligned with corporate financial objectives.

·Perform detailed planning analysis on attainment of Strategic goals and financial results as well as Business Case support for new products, projects, and proposals.

·Responsible for analysis of collection center business measurements, making recommendations for improvement in all areas of analysis. Included, but not limited to; budgets, dollars collected/call/write-offs, service measurements, staffing needs and strategies that will increase collection of billed revenue and minimize bad debt and credits.

·Provide collection center representation in the development programs that will increase efficiencies as well as those that will decrease net bad debt: such as, but not limited to, consolidations/conversions, financial and operational goals.

·Responsible for process measurement tools and identifying opportunities for efficiency improvements.

·Personally lead high-stakes negotiations and structure complex payment arrangements or settlements for major delinquent accounts.

·Act as the primary escalation point for complex billing, pricing, or contract disputes, ensuring swift and diplomatic resolution.

·Ensure strict compliance with commercial collection laws, corporate compliance frameworks, and internal auditing standards.

Team Leadership, Training, and Performance

·Responsible for establishing collection center teams and managing status of all activity; ensure timeliness and effective roll outs in the collection center.

·Responsible for training and develop programs in response to the data, also identify training opportunities and team with Training to address them.

·Directly accountable for the development of Coaching and leadership of Collection teams.

·Responsible for participating/assembling teams to drive performance, motivation and recognize employees, tracking status and implementing changes where appropriate.

Cross-Functional Operations and Project Management

·Interface with all Collection teams, Contact Centers, Field Ops, I.S., Rev Ops, Sales, Regulatory, PSC and outside vendors for the development and documentation of Collection related activity and business processes.

·Partner with Sales and Account Management leadership to strike a balance between commercial revenue growth and prudent risk mitigation.

·Manage external partnerships with credit insurance firms, third-party collection agencies, and liquidators.

·Coordinate with internal and external counsel to initiate legal proceedings, or asset recovery operations when necessary.

CABS Collections and Billing Dispute Resolution

·Manage the end-to-end collections process for Carrier Access Billing Systems (CABS), focusing on Switched Access, Special Access, and unbundled network elements (UNEs).

·Investigate and resolve complex billing disputes stemming from Meet-Point Billing (MPB) agreements, disputed Access Service Requests (ASRs), circuit disconnect timing, and operational lease variances.

·Support sourcing, implementation, documentation, and optimization of third-party operational solutions and support models.

·Experience managing third-party collection agencies, service providers, or other external vendors.

You will work closely with the Platform Integrations and Platform Services teams when new data connections are required, but your team is the primary engineering point of contact for broker partners and will interface directly with them throughout the delivery lifecycle.

The right candidate is a seasoned engineer with deep full-stack expertise, strong client-facing instincts, and the ability to translate broker-specific requirements into platform-generic solutions that scale across the CEM client base. You will bring an AI-first mindset — genuinely integrating agentic development tooling into your daily workflow and setting the standard for your team.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for the Broker Applications team — making day-to-day engineering decisions, setting the bar for code quality, and ensuring the team delivers high-quality software on schedule.
  • Write, review, and contribute production-quality code across the full stack — C#/.NET, Angular, and Oracle — as an active, hands-on member of the team.
  • Lead architecture discussions and make technical recommendations that align with the long-term CEM platform strategy — ensuring broker-specific work generalizes across the broader client base wherever possible.
  • Hold the team accountable to engineering standards — unit testing, code review discipline, definition of done, and release readiness.
  • Partner with Platform Integrations and Platform Services teams to design and implement new data connections required for broker onboarding and feature delivery.

AI-First Engineering

  • Champion ≥50% AI-authored PR targets and ≥95% AI code review adoption as organizational minimums for your team.
  • Model an agentic development mindset — integrating AI tooling into your own daily workflow and actively coaching teammates to do the same.
  • Push the team beyond baseline AI adoption into workflows and practices that measurably improve delivery velocity and code quality.
  • Stay current on agentic development tooling and bring forward-looking recommendations to the Engineering Manager.

Broker Onboarding & Partner Engagement

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for broker-dealer partners — engaging directly on requirements, integration design, technical issue resolution, and delivery status.
  • Lead the technical execution of new broker onboarding engagements — translating partner-specific requirements into well-scoped, platform-generic solutions.
  • Dig into root business problems rather than accepting requirements at face value; advocate for solutions that work across the full broker partner portfolio rather than one-off builds.
  • Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product Management to ensure broker requirements are well-defined, properly scoped, and sequenced for delivery.
  • Build credibility with broker partners through technical depth, delivery consistency, and clear communication.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Platform Integrations and Platform Services teams on new data connections, integration patterns, and shared technical standards.
  • Coordinate with matrixed QA engineers to ensure test coverage, quality gates, and release readiness are met across broker-specific workflows.
  • Collaborate with Principal Engineers, the Solution Architect, and peer Lead Engineers on cross-team technical decisions.
  • Surface delivery risks, technical blockers, and scope concerns to the Engineering Manager early and clearly.

Technical Mentorship

  • Set the technical bar for the team — establishing coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering practices the rest of the team follows.
  • Mentor engineers on full-stack development best practices, broker integration patterns, and professional development.
  • Contribute to cross-team technical forums alongside Principal Engineers, the Solution Architect, and Engineering Managers.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in enterprise SaaS environments, with demonstrated experience as a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer.
  • Deep full-stack expertise in C#, .NET (Framework and/or Core), Angular, and Oracle — able to contribute meaningfully and lead technical decisions across the entire stack.
  • Strong proficiency in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) — hands-on experience with domain model layering across application, service, and data access tiers.
  • Experience with CQRS patterns for command/query separation in multi-service architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience in client-facing engineering roles — comfortable engaging directly with external partners on requirements, design decisions, and technical issue resolution.
  • Proven ability to advocate for platform-generic solutions over one-off client-specific builds — experience pushing back on requirements that don't generalize.
  • Demonstrated AI-first engineering mindset — hands-on experience with agentic development tooling and a track record of driving AI adoption within an engineering team.
  • Strong code review discipline and engineering quality standards — unit testing, CI/CD hygiene, definition-of-done rigor.
  • Experience with Oracle databases including PL/SQL development — packages, procedures, views, and query optimization.
  • Experience with Angular 15+ including Reactive Forms, RxJS, Angular Material, and TypeScript.
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core including Oracle EF Core provider.
  • 3+ years of experience with Azure cloud technologies and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working in global, distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred

  • Experience working in broker-dealer, financial services, or equity compensation domains — familiarity with broker integration patterns, FIX protocol concepts, or equity plan administration.
  • Familiarity with .NET modernization patterns — experience working across legacy ASP.NET Web API (.NET Framework) and modern ASP.NET Core services in parallel.
