jobs.excerpt: Who We're Looking For:We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster.
jobs.description:
Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster. These areas include developer reach, testing, sandboxing, metering, and deployment of AI and human generated code.

As agentic build tools compress the time it takes to author a change, the bottleneck moves downstream. Testing and deploying safely to production is already one of the loudest customer asks and one of the sharpest pain points on the platform. When changes originate from agents as well as people, and arrive at a much higher rate, the ability to validate and trust them quickly stops being a quality-of-life improvement and becomes a precondition for platform growth. You will lead the team that enables this for developers.

This is not four adjacent feature areas with a shared manager. Customers experience the SDLC as one motion, and the central product challenge of this role is the connective tissue: a sandbox that behaves like the instance you will deploy to, a test suite that knows what changed, a release path that carries the evidence, and a model for building directly in production that an admin can actually govern. You set the strategy that makes their roadmaps resolve into a single lifecycle rather than four products that ship past each other.

The scope is deeply technical and close to execution. The Developer Reach feature area alone unlocks a path to building in production that admins can manage at scale without losing control, and it demands real technical depth to steer. You will also carry a broad surface, over twenty product areas, with the escalation volume that comes with it, and you will need to run that operational load without letting it consume the strategic work.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across Developer Reach, Developer Sandboxes, Agentic Testing, and Release Ops, and define how they compose into one lifecycle from authored change to governed, audited deployment.

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of PMs, one per area. Set a clear standard for product craft, coach PMs on strategy and execution, and hold the bar on the seams between them: shared primitives, consistent models, and a single coherent customer narrative.

  • Set product direction for validating AI-originated change at scale: what it means to trust an agent's output, what evidence a release needs to carry, and how much of the test and review burden can be automated without losing accountability.

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy, including the product model for building in production with admin control, guardrails, and reversibility at enterprise scale.

  • Define the sandbox strategy: provisioning speed, production parity, data handling, and the developer experience of getting a safe place to work in seconds rather than days.

  • Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental.

  • Shape the metering and cost-modeling strategy for this area in partnership with Pricing & Packaging and Finance, and understand how it impacts the entire App Engine portfolio.

  • Build the triage discipline that keeps escalations across a broad product surface from displacing the roadmap.

  • Model an AI-first way of working: use agentic coding tools directly, build and deploy against your own products, and bring firsthand experience of the pain your customers are describing.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

  • 12+ years of product management experience, including experience leading and growing a team of PMs, with a track record of setting technical strategy independently rather than executing a roadmap someone else defined.

  • A track record of developing PMs, raising the bar on product thinking and execution across a team, and growing earlier-career PMs into strong owners of their areas.

  • Deep experience owning developer platform, DevOps, or SDLC products at enterprise scale: CI/CD, test automation, environment management, release orchestration, or change management.

  • Genuine hands-on technical comfort, including reading code, reasoning about system architecture, and holding your own in design discussions with senior engineers. Direct, regular personal use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf in your own workflow.

  • Experience with enterprise change-management or release-governance systems and the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, ideally including systems that gate deployment through a controlled artifact such as a change set.

  • Ideally, experience with test strategy at scale: automated test generation, coverage and flakiness economics, regression management, and what it takes for a team to actually trust a green build.

  • Familiarity with environment and infrastructure provisioning models, ephemeral environments, production parity, and data seeding or masking, and the cost and security tradeoffs each carries.

  • Working knowledge of agentic development workflows and what changes when a meaningful share of commits originate from an agent rather than a person: review, attribution, validation, and rollback.

  • Proven ability to build and defend an executive-level strategic case, and to navigate cross-business-unit governance and ownership disputes at the VP and SVP level, driving alignment across genuinely contested boundaries.

  • Demonstrated ability to run a high-volume operational surface, triaging escalations and production issues across many product areas while continuing to ship against a multi-year strategy.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into a strategy that lands with engineers and with executive stakeholders in the same conversation.

Why join us?

  • Own the part of the platform that decides whether agentic development is safe enough for enterprises to adopt, at the moment that question is being answered.

  • Take four high-stakes bets that are currently separate and make them feel like one product, with the mandate and the team to actually do it.

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy for bringing agentic development on the Now platform to any developer in an organization, and the broader production-build model, one of the most technically ambitious efforts in the org and a direct answer to a long-standing customer ask.

  • Operate at the center of the Platform Agentic Build Lifecycle org during the shift to AI-native software development, with influence over how changes get tested, governed, and released rather than only how they get written.

  • Grow a team of PMs at the point where the platform’s velocity ceiling is actually set.

Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads. We're a small but rapidly growing company, which means there's lots of room for growth and learning opportunities abound!

Apiphani is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all as a fundamental component of our business. Diversity and inclusion are the bedrock of creativity and innovation. About the role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building Luumen () — our agentic AI platform for enterprise IT automation.

You'll own the team responsible for the SSH client, the web application, and the backend services behind them — a team of 6–8 engineers across those workstreams.

This is a hands-on leadership role at a Series A startup. We expect you to spend the majority of your time on management, architecture, and unblocking the team — but we also expect you to stay close enough to the code to make credible technical calls, review designs with depth, and occasionally ship something yourself when it matters. Roughly ~20% hands-on is a reasonable baseline; the exact mix will flex with what the team needs.

You'll partner closely with our PM on roadmap, tech debt prioritization, and sequencing work across the team. You'll report to the VP of Product & Engineering.

What you'll do

  • Lead a team of 6–8 engineers across the SSH client, web application, and backend services — running 1:1s, performance management, mentorship, career growth, and day-to-day delivery.
  • Own technical architecture across the stack you're responsible for — frontend systems, terminal/SSH client patterns, backend service design, API contracts, performance, and the long-term shape of the codebase.
  • Drive engineering process. Define how the team plans, ships, and learns. Introduce lightweight rituals where they help (sprint cadence, code review, on-call, incident response) and resist process that slows the team down.
  • Partner with Product on roadmap, tech debt prioritization, and translating customer needs into engineering work. Help sequence what the team builds and make the tradeoffs explicit.
  • Stay technical. Review architecture proposals, unblock engineers, challenge technical tradeoffs, step in during incidents, and contribute code when it's the highest-leverage thing you can do (~20% of your time, give or take).
  • Hire and build the team. Source, interview, sell, and onboard engineers. Help define rubrics and shape the culture as we scale.
  • Communicate across the org. Translate technical risk and tradeoffs to founders, product, design, and customer-facing teams. Operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

What we're looking for

  • 5–10+ years of engineering experience, with meaningful time as a senior engineer or tech lead before moving into management.
  • 1–5+ years managing engineers directly — hiring, 1:1s, performance management, sprint/process ownership, career development.
  • Strong full-stack technical depth. You've built and shipped non-trivial systems on both sides of the wire and can speak credibly about frontend architecture, backend service design, API contracts, and the tradeoffs between them. Familiarity with terminal/CLI clients (TUI frameworks, SSH, CLI ergonomics) is a plus.
  • Track record building process from scratch. You've taken a team from "startup chaos" to predictable delivery without importing big-company bureaucracy. You know when process helps and when it kills velocity.
  • Hiring and team-building experience. You've sourced, interviewed, closed, and onboarded engineers — and you have a point of view on what makes a strong engineering culture.
  • Cross-functional fluency. Comfortable working directly with founders, product, design, and customers. You can communicate technical risk clearly and handle ambiguity without waiting for someone to hand you a spec.
  • Pragmatic, ownership-oriented mindset. You make calls with incomplete information, take responsibility for outcomes, and don't need layers of management to operate.

Bonus points

  • Experience at an earlier-stage startup (Seed–Series B)
  • Background in developer tools, infrastructure tooling, or other technical-user-facing products
  • Exposure to AI/LLM-powered product surfaces or AI-augmented workflows
  • Experience scaling an engineering team through a meaningful growth phase (e.g., 5 → 15 or 15 → 40 engineers)
  • Familiarity with our stack (TypeScript, Python, AWS)
  • Customer-facing experience — discovery calls, design partner conversations, debugging in production with users

Why join Apiphani

You'll be joining a globally distributed, high-performing team focused on redefining how enterprises manage infrastructure. As the EM for Luumen, you'll own the team behind the product — the SSH client, the web app, and the backend services that bring agentic AI to enterprise IT.

This is a role with real scope: you'll own a meaningful team across the full product stack, set technical direction, and help build the engineering culture as we grow.

jobs.title: Simulation V&V Manager
jobs.excerpt: What you will do: As the Simulation Test Manager, you will lead a team of simulation test engineers responsible for the virtual verification and validation (V&V) of Torc’s autonomous truck.
jobs.description:
What you will do:
As the Simulation Test Manager, you will lead a team of simulation test engineers responsible for the virtual verification and validation (V&V) of Torc’s autonomous truck. You will set the strategic and technical direction for the team, ensuring that simulation-based evidence for both perception and autonomous behavior supports Torc’s safety case and aligns with industry standards including ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 8800, and ISO 26262. You will also partner with development, integration, and safety teams and be instrumental in growing the robustness and safety of our self-driving technology.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of simulation test engineers, setting clear goals, priorities, and development plans.
  • Define and own the scaled simulation V&V strategy, roadmap, and technical direction for the team in support of Torc’s autonomous truck safety case.
  • Ensure simulation test methods, processes, and evidence align with ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 8800, and ISO 26262.
  • Partner with Product, Systems, and Safety teams to translate requirements, hazardous, and ODD definitions into simulation V&V strategies and release-readiness criteria.
  • Plan and oversee simulation test campaigns, including resourcing, scheduling, and delivery against program milestones.
  • Guide the evolution of Torc’s Scenario Library, containing Abstract, Logical, and Concrete scenarios, to ensure robust ODD coverage and traceability to requirements.
  • Identify testing gaps and drive requirements for new or improved test tools, simulation environments, and test frameworks; manage relationships with internal tools teams and external vendors to evolve Torc’s simulation and virtual testing toolchains.
  • Review simulation results and communicate V&V status, risks, and findings to engineering leadership and stakeholders through dashboards and test reports.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field with 6+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with 4+ years of experience.

  • Experience leading virtual testing and simulation of perception and autonomous vehicle behavior.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and ISO 8800, and how they apply to simulation-based verification and validation.
  • Experience defining test strategy and overseeing the development of simulation scenarios and Test cases with traceability to requirements.
  • Familiarity with scenario-based testing and the ASAM OpenSCENARIO standard, especially Abstract and/or Logical Scenarios.
  • Technical depth in Python and SQL for data analysis.
  • Experience with software and system troubleshooting and problem-solving with specific focus on system-level analysis, fault isolation, and identification.
  • Working knowledge of probability, statistics, and linear algebra, including their use in coverage and statistical validation arguments.
  • Experience managing cross-functional partners, internal tools teams, and external simulation vendors.
  • Experience effectively reporting progress and test results to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Familiar with the state-of-the-art approaches of autonomous vehicle validation.

Bonus Points!
ADAS verification and validation experience.

  • Experience contributing to safety cases or safety assurance arguments, including simulation tool qualification (e.g., ISO 26262 tool confidence).
  • Experience with developing & validating sensor models, traffic vehicle models, and vehicle dynamics models.
  • Experience evaluating and interacting with ROS based systems.
  • Experience hiring, building, and scaling engineering teams.

$160,800—$193,000 USD

jobs.title: Product Adoption & Enablement Manager - Remote
jobs.excerpt: No other company in our industry is supercharging the way they work and serve their clients like OneDigital.
jobs.description:
No other company in our industry is supercharging the way they work and serve their clients like OneDigital. Fresh thinking has always been the core of OneDigital’s vision and growth strategy. It’s how we stand out in our industry, it’s how we stay competitive and resilient in a changing world. Most importantly, our innovative approach is helping more people do their best work and live their best lives. Innovation fuels our employee experience by making it easier to do your best work anytime, anywhere and from any device. And our tech-based products for clients are a game changer in our industry. If you thrive on change and innovation, OneDigital is the career choice for you.

Our Newest Opportunity:

Summary
The Product Adoption & Enablement Manager drives the adoption of every product OneDigital builds and launches.This role is the dedicated adoption and enablement partner to our Product Managers, owning the rollout planning, communication, coordination, and champion-network mechanics that turn a release into real usage, so Product Managers can stay focused on product strategy and delivery.


The role works across the full suite of applications supported and launched by the Product team, including applications added to the portfolio over time. It is embedded in how the Product team operates, plugged into roadmaps and the operating rhythm closely enough to know what is coming, where each initiative sits in the rollout lifecycle, who is impacted, and what the communication, training, and enablement motion needs to look like. It is involved early enough to own adoption and enablement strategy across the portfolio proactively, rather than receiving a finished release and reacting to it.


While accountable for building and executing structured rollout and adoption plans and for surfacing actionable insights, this role partners with Product Managers and business leaders, who retain accountability for KPIs and business results. The role exists to support the Product Management team, not to substitute for it. Product Managers remain accountable for ensuring their applications have the functionality and usability users need. This role is accountable for ensuring users know how to use each application, understand what it can and cannot do today, are getting the most out of what exists right now, and are encouraged toward adoption overall.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Portfolio Visibility & Adoption Strategy

  • Participate in the Product team's operating rhythm, including roadmap reviews, planning and prioritization discussions, and release readiness checkpoints, as a standing member of the team rather than an occasional invitee.
  • Maintain a forward view of the portfolio: what is coming, on what timeline, where each initiative sits in the rollout lifecycle, and which audiences are affected.
  • Own the adoption and enablement strategy across the portfolio, determining the communication, training, and enablement motion each initiative warrants, and sequencing that work across applications.
  • Engage upstream, while releases are still being shaped, so adoption and enablement needs inform rollout timing, sequencing, and readiness rather than being addressed after the fact.
  • Assess change impact early: who is affected, how significant the change is for them, and what level of support it warrants.
  • Coordinate with L&D to ensure users know how to use each application and understand its current capabilities and limitations. Where adoption is constrained by missing functionality or usability problems, surface it clearly to the responsible Product Manager, who owns remediation.
  • Remove adoption and enablement planning from each Product Manager's individual workload, replacing it with one consistent approach applied across the portfolio.

User Release Communication

  • Own the drafting, publishing, and sending of release notes and platform updates to the user base across all Product-supported applications.
  • Translate technical and product inputs from Product Managers into clear, user-facing language that explains what changed, why it matters, and what the user needs to do.
  • Own messaging consistency for release notes and platform updates; define and maintain the templates, cadence, tone, and quality standards so communication is consistent across applications.
  • Manage the release communication calendar, sequencing updates across applications to avoid overloading shared audiences.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications, where required, on enterprise-wide message consistency across every channel, including larger company-wide communication initiatives where a release requires broader reach than the standard user channels.

Rollout Planning & Coordination

  • Develop tailored rollout plans for each initiative, flexing the approach to the size, audience, and complexity of the product or feature, based on an underlying repeatable framework those plans draw from.
  • Align rollout plans with business objectives through close engagement with business stakeholders, so each rollout is tied to what the business is trying to achieve.
  • Orchestrate delivery across contributing teams to support application and functionality rollouts.
  • Coordinate with the L&D team to schedule and stand up training support tied to releases, including where a rollout plan calls for tailored or audience-specific training.
  • Coordinate with Marketing to promote enablement content such as success stories and customer proof points.
  • Guide and partner with L&D and Marketing, where required, on their workstreams, including training, enablement, and messaging, to align with the strategic adoption plan.
  • Track rollout dependencies, timelines, and handoffs, and keep Product Managers and contributing teams aligned on who owns what and by when.
  • Flag coordination risks and blockers early so Product Managers can adjust rollout timing or sequencing.

Champion Network Governance Support

  • Support the governance of the champion network across the product portfolio.
  • Help Product Managers formalize how champions are recruited, trained, and activated.
  • Maintain the operating mechanics of the network, including rosters, onboarding, communication rhythms, and activation playbooks, so Product Managers are not rebuilding the process for each launch.
  • Serve as a consistent point of contact for champions and route their questions and feedback to the right Product Manager or team.

Adoption Support

  • Monitor and interpret utilization metrics and adoption statistics across supported applications using existing reporting and dashboards.
  • Surface insights and patterns, including where adoption is lagging, which segments are stalling, and what is working, rather than reporting raw numbers.
  • Partner with Product Managers to develop and refine strategies to increase adoption based on what the data shows.
  • Recommend additional metrics worth tracking where current reporting does not answer the adoption questions Product Managers need answered.
  • Close the loop after launches by capturing what drove adoption and feeding those learnings into the next rollout plan.

Qualifications, Skills and Requirements

  • Product communications capability is a priority: demonstrated ability to take a release or a new capability and turn it into clear, engaging communication for the end user, not simply announcing that something launched, but creating genuine interest in it and articulating plainly why it matters to the person using it.
  • Strong writer, able to take technical product input and produce clear, concise, user-facing communication with minimal editing. Writes with energy as well as accuracy, so communication leaves users wanting to try what shipped rather than merely informed that it exists.
  • Understands how Product teams operate, including roadmaps, release cycles, and prioritization trade-offs, and is comfortable being embedded in that rhythm rather than briefed from outside it.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to flex rollout plans and approaches based on product size, audience, and complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional delivery across teams they do not manage.
  • Comfortable working with usage and adoption data; able to read dashboards, spot trends, and translate them into recommendations.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills across business stakeholders, regional leaders, and frontline users.
  • Highly organized; able to run multiple concurrent rollouts across multiple applications without dropping details.
  • Nimble and adaptive; thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Human-centered mindset: keeps employees and clients at the heart of adoption planning.

Education, Training and Experience

  • 4-8 years in product marketing, product operations, adoption/enablement, technical communication, or a comparable role supporting product teams.
  • Demonstrated product communications experience, including translating releases and new capabilities into user-facing communication.
  • Experience working closely with Product teams and being embedded in their roadmap, release, and prioritization rhythm.
  • Previous experience working in or alongside Product teams to coordinate multi-channel rollouts.
  • Experience building or running a champion, super-user, or ambassador network is a strong plus.
  • Strong preference for experience in insurance, benefits, or financial services; exposure to SaaS and digital transformation environments is an advantage.
Your base pay is dependent upon your skills, education, qualifications, professional experience, and location.   • Platform Experience: Experience with cloud-native lakehouse platforms; hands-on experience or familiarity with Microsoft Fabric is highly preferred.

  • AI Tooling: Active experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) to accelerate engineering velocity.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Fabric Lakehouse, Data Factory, Synapse Analytics).

  • Streaming frameworks experience (Event Hubs, Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).

jobs.excerpt: Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together Our Meaningful Mission At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates.
jobs.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel.

About the role
We are changing the way people send money. We’re building digital services that allow people to send and receive money easily. Most of our customers are hard-working migrants in Africa, Asia and Latin America. We’re always seeking to better serve our customers and find ways to improve our product , this role is to help us deliver important new features and innovation in a highly efficient and fast-paced way.

We hire bright people who can work autonomously and make the right decisions. We are looking for an ambitious, results-driven and industry-experienced Senior Product Manager to help drive the business forward. If you are a perceptive leader, enthusiastic problem-solver and strong communicator we look forward to meeting you.

To support Zepz growth strategy and drive maximum impact we are looking for support to drive forward key FinCrime product management strategy and deliveries in the AML/PEP Sanction domain. This will involve applying a cohesive approach to solve different groups of customer needs and ensure a compliant set-up and best-in-class customer experience across the platform in a scalable and streamlined manner.

To fill this role we are looking for a professional that’s comfortable driving change in a dynamic environment across various levels of senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an individual with previous experience in delivering complex digital initiatives that span multiple departments. You will be comfortable owning the full digital product life cycle and have a natural drive to deliver exceptional end-to-end experiences.

The successful applicant will likely also have previous experience in core AML functions such as customer risk rating and transaction monitoring both in implementation, ongoing calibration, best practices and management. The role is heavily data driven and requires someone very analytical to drive the strategy. Experience implementing stable coin, working with on-chain analysis vendors, and experience working with AI vendors to optimise processes is also hugely desirable.

What you will own
As a member of our team reporting to the Product Director - FinCrime, you will:
  • Build and manage stakeholder relationships to gather needs across 50 countries.
  • Help shape the strategy across the fincrime domain across both ZEPZ remittance brands supporting PEP’s/Sanctions/AI vendor roadmap/crypto roadmap (specifically the fincrime elements).
  • Manage vendor relationships and integrations for customer verification, workflow management, and more.
  • Scope, plan, and deliver global feature rollouts in the domain.
  • Develop a clear and coherent product strategy within your area that aligns with the company's vision.
  • Maintain a strong focus on delivering business and user value.
  • Play a crucial role in supporting the growth and scalability of the business.
  • Take ownership and drive the metrics within your area, helping define success and the path to achieve it.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders (and in particular compliance) throughout the organization to deeply understand problems, identify opportunities, and explore potential solutions.
  • Effectively manage stakeholders, knowing when to listen and when to deliver challenging messages.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to drive product decisions and features.

What you bring to the table
You’ll be an experienced Sr Product Manager in the digital FinCrime space
  • Have strong knowledge in the Finance/FinTech and FinCrime space - experience in stable coin and AI is desirable
  • You are a creative thinker, problem-solver, strong communicator across various levels of stakeholders, you are driven and are thriving when taking full ownership for your product area
  • You are data driven and comfortable working with models, ideally with experience in customer risk rating and transaction monitoring
  • You are hands-on, enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are a natural self-starter
  • You build strong relationships with your development team, work to good agile practices and collaborate effectively with product design.
  • You’re a natural leader. You lead initiatives from ideas to delivery. You help the team deliver with an MVP mindset, but still build towards and share longer term visions.
  • You have a good understanding of relevant technology, how it applies to our business. You use this information when making trade-off and priority decisions.
  • You have strong experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • You have a proven track record of being a great communicator, working with different stakeholders from across the business.
  • You are not afraid of taking on ambiguous initiatives and turning them into a set of clear goals and tangible outcomes
  • You are knowledgeable about Agile / Lean software delivery methodologies and practices
  • You have experience in gathering functional and nonfunctional requirements, writing user stories and mapping out processes
  • You are a team player with the commercial mindset to drive tech work for highest business impact
  • Good technical and business understanding based on previous experience in financial services/compliance
  • A strong understanding of current regulations and best practices in compliance
  • Manage the integration work with technology partners (workflows, APIs, error scenarios and management) from ideation to delivery on production and beyond
  • Work against tight regulatory deadlines

AI Literacy & Tools

As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work, from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context, whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy. An understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

jobs.excerpt: Maximize your potential.  Minimize your footprint.
jobs.description:
Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.

Job Summary

The Vice President of Program Management serves as the cross-functional integrator and accountability mechanism for customer commitments across the entire program lifecycle at Nortek Data Center Cooling. This executive-level role leads custom and configurable development programs, ensuring flawless execution from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.

The VP of Program Management coordinates Engineering, Test, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, Finance, and Service teams to meet schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments, while these functions continue to own execution within their respective areas. This position is accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance; Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy. Program Management maintains direct customer contact, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer contact and owns customer communication and negotiation. Leading a team of customer-assigned Program Managers, the role drives cross-functional alignment, manages contract and program risk, and establishes scalable program management processes that enable consistent execution as the business scales beyond $2B.

Key Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end program health from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning, ensuring all commitments established during the PAR, customer quotation, technical submittal, and budgeting processes are achieved.
  • Manage the cross-functional team to schedule with a relentless focus on critical-path items, driving flawless execution of development and production programs that exceed customer expectations for on-time delivery, quality, service, and sustainability.
  • Establish structured workflows for project kickoff, engineering release, drawing approval cycles, long-lead procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, customer acceptance, installation, and commissioning.
  • Continuously refine program execution practices to reduce rework, minimize delays caused by engineering changes, and improve cross-functional predictability.
  • Define program intake and scoping processes that incorporate feasibility assessments, technical requirements, material constraints, and manufacturing capacity considerations.

Program Risk Management

  • Implement a robust program risk management process that establishes clear methodologies, governance, and expectations for Program Managers across all programs.
  • Deploy a standardized risk identification, escalation, and mitigation process across all major programs, targeting a 90% on-time closure rate for critical risks.
  • Maintain executive visibility to top program risks through monthly reviews and prevent significant schedule, cost, quality, or customer impacts resulting from unmanaged risks.
  • Ensure every high-risk issue has a documented mitigation plan and appropriate executive visibility.

Program-Level P&L and Contract Management

  • Accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance. Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy.
  • Ensure all financial commitments established during the deal model, quotation, contract negotiation, and budgeting processes are achieved, with Sales leading customer negotiation and pricing strategy.
  • Manage change orders, warranty exposure, and cash flow throughout the program lifecycle while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to profitability.
  • Partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Service teams to drive cost, schedule, and scope decisions that maximize both customer satisfaction and business performance.
  • Own the contract governance processes that provide visibility to key obligations, risks, change orders, opportunities, and customer commitments to optimize profitability and reduce contractual risk.

Installation, Commissioning & Service Coordination

  • Ensure Service has visibility to installation schedules and customer requirements.
  • Ensure field resources, parts, and support plans are aligned with program commitments.
  • Coordinate and escalate warranty issues, field modifications, or customer concerns.
  • Track financial and customer impacts associated with post-delivery issues.
  • Remain engaged whenever there are material issues impacting customer commitments, schedule, economics, or customer satisfaction; support formal handoff to Service when programs are running smoothly.
  • Service continues to own service execution (contracting, product offering, productivity, reliability, and overall quality), technician deployment and training, spare parts strategy, and long-term aftermarket support (e.g., Re-life).

Portfolio Visibility & Performance Analytics

  • Develop real-time dashboards that track critical ETO and NPD program indicators—engineering release progress, procurement status for long-lead items, fabrication readiness, machine/line capacity, and shop-floor schedule adherence.
  • Implement portfolio dashboards that visualize backlog health, load vs. capacity, customer delivery commitments, and risk areas across concurrent custom programs.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Service, and Finance to consolidate data into a single source of truth for program performance, resource demand, and material readiness.
  • Ensure dashboards highlight bottlenecks—overdue drawings, supplier delays, part shortages, manufacturing constraints, and field/commissioning issues—to support proactive decision-making.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • By year-end, build and develop a high-performing Program Management organization capable of successfully managing 100% of Nortek DCC development and production programs.
  • Establish standardized processes and templates for program execution, program-level P&L management, contract management, and risk management.
  • Manage, coach, and mentor Program Managers and cross-functional contributors to ensure consistent, high-quality program execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, proactive communication, and continuous improvement across the program organization.
  • Represent Program Management at the executive level, partnering with peers across Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, and Service to shape enterprise strategy and priorities.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in program or project management, including significant executive leadership responsibility over multi-program portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success owning program-level P&L execution, contract governance, and customer commitments on large, complex capital-equipment programs.
  • Proven success building, leading, and scaling program management organizations in a fast-growth environment.
  • Strong command of program management methodologies, governance frameworks, and tools (e.g., Monday.com, Microsoft Project, PLM systems).
  • Deep experience managing complex, cross-functional new product development and engineer-to-order production programs, including installation and commissioning coordination.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to influence at every level of the organization and directly with customers.
  • Highly persuasive, proactive, adaptable, and capable of leading through change.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills across technical, commercial, operational, and service teams.
  • Ability to understand, adopt, and drive new technologies and processes.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment; able to prioritize, manage multiple initiatives, and consistently meet deadlines.

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification or equivalent.
  • Experience establishing or leading an enterprise PMO or program governance function at scale.
  • Direct experience with engineered-to-order products, specifically large business-to-business sales of capital equipment.
  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers or other rapidly scaling B2B end markets.

Why Join Nortek DCC

  • Play an important role on a growing team
  • Contribute to a company helping power the next generation of AI‑ready data centers
  • Work in an environment with meaningful growth opportunities

jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

The Senior Contract Analyst is responsible for ensuring the outpatient and specialty audit teams operate from correct, current payer-provider contracts and payer reimbursement policies. This role identifies and documents contract terms with audit opportunity, including carve-out payments, and maintains the concept matrix that defines which outpatient concepts are applied to each client.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring independent judgment, good judgment and decisive action in complex or evolving situations, and sound escalation practices. The role requires exceptional organization, the ability to manage a high volume of detail with accuracy, and adaptability to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment. Clear communication is essential, including the ability to translate complex contract and policy language for auditors, client-facing teams, and leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Accuracy and Governance

  • Serve as the single source of truth for payer-provider contracts and reimbursement policies supporting outpatient and specialty audit programs.
  • Validate that audit teams have the correct contract version, amendments, fee schedules, and effective dates before audits are performed.
  • Build and maintain a contract inventory with version control, renewal tracking, and a clear audit trail of changes.
  • Identify missing, expired, or outdated contracts and drive resolution before audit work is affected.

Audit Opportunity Documentation

  • Review contracts to identify and abstract terms with audit opportunity, including carve-out payments, implant and device provisions, high-cost drug terms, stop-loss and outlier thresholds, lesser-of language, bundling and packaging rules, and exclusions.
  • Translate contract language into clear, usable documentation that auditors can apply consistently.
  • Flag ambiguous or conflicting contract language and escalate with a recommended interpretation.
  • Partner with audit leadership and policy teams to surface new concept opportunities found in contract terms.

Payer Reimbursement Policy Management

  • Maintain the library of payer reimbursement policies supporting outpatient and specialty audit concepts, ensuring the required policies are in place to implement each concept for each client.
  • Monitor payer policy updates, retirements, and effective date changes, and update the policy library and impacted concepts as needed.
  • Identify policy gaps before a concept is implemented for a client and drive resolution with Client Success and the client.
  • Maintain linkage between each concept, its supporting policy, and the client to ensure audit findings are supported by current, defensible policy.
  • Communicate policy changes to audit teams to prevent findings based on outdated or superseded policy.

Outpatient Concept Matrix

  • Own and maintain the concept matrix mapping which outpatient and specialty audit concepts are active, paused, or excluded for each client.
  • Ensure the matrix reflects client-specific contract terms, supporting reimbursement policies, exclusions, and approvals.
  • Establish update cadence, change control, and quality checks to maintain matrix accuracy for Ops, Client Success, and leadership.
  • Provide reporting and insight on concept coverage gaps and expansion opportunities by client.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary contract intelligence partner to Client Success teams, providing clear, specific requests to obtain updated contracts, reimbursement policies, and related information from each client.
  • Track outstanding client requests through resolution.
  • Communicate contract, policy, and concept changes to audit teams to prevent work from being performed on outdated terms.
  • Identify process improvements and support scaling of the contract intake and abstraction workflow as the client base grows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare payment integrity, provider contracting, managed care, claims auditing, or revenue cycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and abstract payer-provider contract terms and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of outpatient reimbursement, including OPPS/APC, fee schedules, percent of charges, and carve-out structures.
  • Working knowledge of payer reimbursement policies and the ability to connect policy language to audit concepts.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude to support contract, policy, and payer research.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience building and maintaining complex tracking tools or matrices.

Preferred

  • Coding or clinical credential (CPC, CCS, RHIA, RHIT, or RN).
  • Experience with specialty audit areas such as implants, high-cost drugs, or infusion services.
  • Experience in a payer, payment integrity vendor, or health system contracting department.
  • Familiarity with contract management platforms and data visualization tools.

Are you excited by the prospect of working with innovative security products?

Do you enjoy creating innovative and strategic solutions to solve complex problems?

Join Our Team

Partner with the best

Join our kernel team, in charge of the network segmentation: building real-time kernel-level enforcement and telemetry for next-generation security products, as well as a new AI Detection and Response (AI-DR) initiative. You’ll develop production-scale software across Linux, Windows, and other platforms, solving complex security challenges. As part of the small senior leaders of the team, you’ll have a direct impact on the product and its technical direction.

As a Principal Kernel Engineer , you will be responsible for:

  • Writing and debugging kernel-level C code across our Linux kernel module, Windows kernel driver, and eBPF programs.
  • Owning end-to-end debugging of complex production issues, including kernel crashes and low-level system failures, while driving root-cause analysis and post-mortems for production environments.

Product Strategy

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

  • Proven experience managing multiple products in parallel as part of a portfolio strategy
  • Proven ability to think strategically and execute tactically. You think beyond products and releases, and are able to elevate the organization to think about value streams and strategic levers

Abilitie is looking for a Client Business Director who is ready to take full ownership of client relationships, navigate complexity confidently, and push the boundaries of leadership development. This is not a passive account management role—it’s an opportunity to own outcomes, build deep trust, and create long-term partnerships that grow both our clients' businesses and our own. Reporting to a Senior Business Partner, this role demands precision in execution, adaptability in approach, and a solutions-oriented mindset in every interaction.

If you thrive in high-stakes environments where success is earned through influence, integrity, and ownership, this could be the perfect role for you.

Who You Are

You measure success not just in sales, but in long-term impact.Experience within the Leadership & Development space is beneficial in building credibility with clients.

  • An Accountability Champion: You take ownership of outcomes—both the wins and the challenges. If something goes wrong, you fix it. If something goes right, you build on it. Project management experience is highly beneficial.
  • A Curious Learner: You seek feedback, embrace new ideas, and stay focused on the long game—knowing that ego has no place in true partnership.

What You Will Do

  • You see sales as a transaction rather than a partnership. Our approach is rooted in trust, not quick wins.
  • You avoid difficult conversations. Success in this role requires delivering hard truths with tact and confidence.
  • You struggle with feedback and iteration. Growth comes from learning, adjusting, and improving—both personally and professionally.
  • You need a rigid structure to be effective. This role demands adaptability, creative problem-solving, and flexibility in the face of changing priorities.

  • High Impact – As a valued Abilitie employee, each contribution you make will have high visibility and drive real business.
  • Freedom/Responsibility – Our company is built around empowering individuals (both as our mission and internally) to be their best selves. This means our employees can work in a way that brings them energy and drives value!

Who We Are

Abilitie is an award-winning leadership development organization, recognized by Inc Magazine as one of the 2019, 2020 & 2022 Best Workplaces in America and one of the 2020 Fastest Growing Companies in America. Check out more of our awards and recognitions here:

We create world-class experiences that inspire, shape, and develop through highly differentiated learning programs, tools for self-discovery, and networks that expand opportunities. Our employees are a diverse and inclusive team of passionate, hardworking individuals. Abilitie is committed to creating an environment where our employees can do the best work of their lives.   • Drive growth and commercialization strategies that improve adoption, retention, market position, and business results.
  • Communicate product decisions, results, progress, and risks clearly to the Board, Executive Leadership, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders.

Core Skills

Education & Certifications

System Knowledge

About the Role

For our client, we are looking for two experienced Project Managers to join the delivery function of a UK financial services organisation.

These are long-term B2B contract roles focused on managing business and IT change initiatives end to end. You will report into the Delivery Manager and take ownership of multiple projects in parallel, ensuring effective governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, budget control, and clear delivery reporting.

The role requires strong communication skills and confidence working directly with UK stakeholders on a daily basis. The client places particular emphasis on communication quality, clarity, and the ability to build trust across technical and business teams.

The positions are remote and suitable for candidates based in Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, or Poland with EU nationality. Occasional travel to the UK is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage business and IT change projects from initiation through delivery and closure.
  • Run multiple projects in parallel while maintaining clear priorities and delivery control.
  • Define and manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Maintain effective project governance and ensure delivery processes are followed consistently.
  • Manage change-control processes and assess the impact of scope or requirement changes.
  • Track project progress and provide clear, accurate status reporting to senior stakeholders.
  • Coordinate delivery activities across business, technology, and operational teams.
  • Facilitate project planning, milestone tracking, and dependency management.
  • Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation actions to resolution.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Support budget tracking and financial control across assigned projects.
  • Ensure project documentation is current, structured, and suitable for governance reviews.
  • Work closely with the Delivery Manager and other project stakeholders to maintain delivery momentum.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery practices.
  • Support successful handover and closure of completed initiatives.

Essential Requirements

  • Around 6–8 years of hands-on project management experience.
  • Current or very recent experience in a project delivery role.
  • Strong experience managing business and/or IT change projects end to end.
  • Ability to manage several projects in parallel.
  • Solid understanding of delivery governance.
  • Practical experience with change control.
  • Strong experience managing risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Experience managing project scope, timelines, and budgets.
  • Strong status-reporting skills for senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with UK stakeholders.
  • English at C1 level or equivalent professional fluency, both spoken and written.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Stable and consistent recent project-management career history.
  • EU nationality.
  • Based in Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, or Poland.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to the UK.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote, international environment.

Preferred Requirements

  • Consultancy or professional delivery-organisation experience.
  • Financial services experience.
  • Experience in another regulated industry.
  • Exposure to large programmes with multiple workstreams.
  • Experience working across both business and technology change.
  • Scrum certification.
  • PRINCE2 certification or equivalent project-management qualification.
  • Previous experience working with UK-based organisations or stakeholders.

What We Value

We value Project Managers who combine strong delivery discipline with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. You should be comfortable taking ownership, maintaining structure in complex environments, and keeping projects moving even when priorities or dependencies change.

The ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally with senior stakeholders is especially important. We are looking for people who can build trust, surface issues early, and provide a clear view of project status without unnecessary complexity.

What You Can Expect

  • Long-term engagement rather than a short-term project assignment.
  • Responsibility for business and IT change projects from start to finish.
  • Daily interaction with UK stakeholders.
  • A role within an established delivery function, reporting to a Delivery Manager.
  • Opportunity to manage several projects in parallel.
  • Remote working from Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, or Poland.
  • Occasional travel to the UK.
  • Exposure to financial-services change initiatives.

What We Offer

  • Project / Industry: Financial services; business and IT change delivery.
  • Location: Remote from Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, or Poland.
  • Contract Type: B2B contractor.
  • Compensation: €40–45/hour.
  • Start Date: ASAP.
  • Work Model: Remote, with occasional travel to the UK.
  • Eligibility: EU nationality required.
  • Open Positions: 2.
  • Engagement: Long-term assignment.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening: Applications are reviewed within 24 hours.
  • Pre-Screening Interview: A brief Q&A session, automated or with a recruiter, designed to learn more about your experience related to the position.
    1. Automated Session (Recommended) – You can complete the session independently at a convenient time. The structured questions and follow-ups are designed to capture detailed, role-relevant experience and can support faster hiring-manager feedback.
    2. Session with a Recruiter – You can complete the same pre-screening with a recruiter. The discussion may be less detailed and feedback may take slightly longer.

jobs.title: Principal Product Strategist, AI Engagement Leader
jobs.excerpt: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did.
jobs.description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

About the Role at Able

Able is an AI-native product engineering firm. We partner with organizations that need to move faster, use AI more effectively, and build products that reflect how their teams and customers actually work. We work alongside our clients - embedded, fast, and outcome-obsessed - across industries and stages of product maturity.

This role sits at the center of those engagements. The Principal Product Strategist, AI Engagement Leader will lead discovery, frame opportunities, align decision-makers, define the path to value, and remain accountable as recommendations become product decisions and product decisions become shipped software. The role also helps shape how Able itself works: improving the use of AI across strategy, design, and delivery, and creating a repeatable product discipline that strengthens every engagement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients view this person as a trusted senior partner who can make complex, ambiguous work feel clear and actionable.
  • Able produces more consistent, rigorous discovery, product strategy, workflow analysis, and recommendation artifacts across engagements.
  • AI opportunities are evaluated pragmatically - with attention to user value, workflow readiness, data, governance, feasibility, evaluation, and change management.
  • The current PM and design team receive stronger coaching, clearer standards, and better tools to do exceptional work.
  • Able has a practical roadmap for the future product strategy and design practice, including capabilities, hiring needs, and AI-enabled ways of working.

Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in product strategy, product management, design strategy, consulting, agency work, startup leadership, or a closely related product leadership role; 10+ years preferred.
  • 2+ years leading product and/or design work through direct management, functional leadership, practice-building responsibility, or leadership of complex multidisciplinary engagements.
  • Strong consulting acumen, including leading client discovery, facilitating workshops, shaping recommendations, and building credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting pre-sales and account growth: participating in early client conversations, framing engagement approaches, contributing to proposals or SOWs, estimating work, and presenting a clear point of view.
  • Demonstrated ownership across the full product lifecycle, from ambiguous opportunity framing and discovery through build, launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Hands-on experience designing, validating, or shipping AI-enabled products, agents, automations, internal tools, or AI-assisted workflows - with practical judgment about where AI creates leverage and where it introduces risk or unnecessary complexity.
  • Proficiency using AI applications to improve product work, including research, synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, requirements, documentation, and delivery practices.
  • Experience partnering directly with product design, software engineering, and AI engineering teams; able to engage in technical feasibility, architecture, data, evaluation, and governance conversations without needing to be the primary engineer.
  • Proven ability to translate messy and sometimes conflicting stakeholder input into a clear problem definition, prioritized opportunity set, and defensible recommendation.
  • Comfort building lightweight business cases and articulating value using incomplete data, explicit assumptions, proxies, and outcome-oriented metrics.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including client-facing synthesis briefs, opportunity maps, PRDs, roadmaps, and executive recommendation decks.
  • Startup, consulting, agency, venture studio, or similarly entrepreneurial operating experience strongly preferred.

Responsibilities

Client and Engagement Leadership

  • Build and maintain trusted client relationships, serving as a senior thought partner to product, business, technical, and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead discovery on client engagements: stakeholder interviews, workflow and process analysis, opportunity framing, AI use-case mapping, value articulation, and prioritized recommendations.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces by surfacing assumptions, clarifying decisions, making risks and tradeoffs visible, and creating shared alignment around the path forward.
  • Facilitate executive workshops and working sessions that move teams from disconnected input to clear priorities, product direction, and next steps.
  • Develop clear, persuasive written artifacts - including briefs, opportunity maps, product strategy documents, PRDs, roadmaps, and client-facing recommendation decks.

Product Ownership, Delivery, and AI Product Strategy

  • Maintain product ownership through build and implementation: translating strategy into buildable work, supporting sprint planning and backlog decisions, and keeping delivery grounded in client outcomes.
  • Partner closely with product design, engineering, and AI engineering to validate feasibility, shape product and architecture tradeoffs, and make practical sequencing decisions.
  • Define outcome hypotheses, success measures, and learning plans; help clients make decisions that balance user value, business impact, feasibility, governance, and time-to-value.
  • Help clients identify, evaluate, and design AI-enabled products and workflows, including agentic experiences, automation opportunities, human-in-the-loop decisions, evaluation approaches, privacy, security, reliability, and change-management needs.
  • Use AI as an extension of the product practice - accelerating research, synthesis, prototyping, documentation, and delivery workflows while maintaining quality and judgment.

Pre-Sales, Account Growth, and Practice Building

  • Support pre-sales efforts by joining early client conversations, helping frame opportunities, developing engagement approaches, contributing to proposals and SOWs, estimating work, and presenting Able's point of view.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and expand impact while protecting trust, delivery quality, and a clear understanding of scope and outcomes.
  • Build and evolve Able's product strategy and design discipline: establish methods, standards, AI-enabled workflows, artifacts, and operating practices that enable exceptional client work today and scale with the company over time.
  • Provide functional leadership, coaching, and quality oversight for Able's current PM and design team; establish expectations for strong discovery, strategy, design collaboration, and delivery.
  • Help define the future structure, capabilities, hiring needs, onboarding approach, and internal tooling roadmap for an AI-native product and design practice.
  • Contribute to the strategy and roadmap for Able's internal platform, tooling, and operating systems when those efforts will strengthen client delivery or the broader practice.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within USA. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • 100% of health, dental and vision insurance coverage.
  • $50 monthly in reimbursements for AI tool subscriptions and costs.
  • We provide the equipment.

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Transitions Care Manager to join our team! The Care Transitions Care Manager provides comprehensive care coordination to support individuals transitioning between care settings and maintaining stability over time. This role assesses needs, develops care plans, and coordinates services across providers and community resources.

This position will serve as a member of the State Hospital integrated care team for the State Psychiatric inpatient setting. The Care Transitions Care Manager is expected to assess and respond to members’ health and safety when the Trillium Catchment is under a state of emergency or weather advisory.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Engage members in the care coordination/care management process.
  • Provide education about all available services, natural and community supports, treatment options, diagnosis, etc.
  • Provide linkage to needed psychological, behavioral, educational, physical, and dental evaluations.
  • Facilitate referrals for health-related services, community-based resources and social support services, and community reintegration supports.
  • Evaluate the outcome of the care plan and reintegration supports.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet Qualified Professional (QP) status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with Long Term Services and Support (LTSS) needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or Home and Community Based Service (HCBS) coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • The following immunizations are required for this position:
    • Fully vaccinated against Influenza (annually within Influenza season Nov 1 – March 31), MMR, Varicella and Tdap (Tetanus, diphtheria pertussis).
    • MMR and Varicella - must show proof of vaccination or have blood drawn to show immunity.
    • Tdap - must show proof of one dose.

At the heart of our Cloud team is a mission to build a secure, scalable, and high-performance platform that powers our cybersecurity products. As a Senior Software Engineer, Cloud, you will own the design, delivery, and operation of critical cloud services, driving architectural decisions and ensuring systems meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and scalability.
