Head of Programme & Network (m/f/d)

Permanent | Full-time | Immediate start | Remote (Germany)

Heimatwurzeln is a not-for-profit organisation with a unique mission: we promote environmental and climate protection for people from the middle classes – in other words, for those who often do not see themselves as part of the climate debate. In doing so, we draw on values such as a sense of belonging to one’s homeland, traditions, pragmatism, a sense of responsibility and common sense. To further develop our organisation, we are looking for an entrepreneurial individual to take charge of the Programme & Networking division.

Your responsibilities

Strategic programme responsibility

  • Responsibility for the further development, prioritisation and coherence of Heimatwurzeln’s programme portfolio as part of the management team, working alongside the executive management and the board of directors

Leadership and Collaboration

Your profile

  • At least 7 years’ relevant professional experience in relevant fields (associations, public affairs, project management, administration/politics, consultancy, etc.) with proven experience in dealing with high-level decision-makers

  • Experience in organisational development and network building, including the coordination of a wide range of partners and stakeholders

  • A very good understanding of the political landscape in Germany, particularly of centre-right and conservative circles

  • Excellent communication skills and a confident manner: able to engage convincingly and engagingly on an equal footing in political, civil society and institutional contexts

  • Analytical and forward-thinking skills, a very good general knowledge and the ability to deal professionally with different perspectives – you identify opportunities, risks and dynamics at an early stage

  • A high degree of personal responsibility, as well as a proactive, forward-thinking and committed approach to work, underpinned by a ‘builder mindset’

  • A team player who enjoys a mix of remote working, on-site projects and nationwide meetings with partners and stakeholders

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English

  • Willingness to undertake regular business trips

Two things make this job different from most SaaS PM roles.

The first is stakes. Payroll has to be right the first time, every time. Our customers are paying tens of thousands of people, on deadlines set by tax authorities rather than by us. Getting that right consistently is one of the things we're proudest of, and protecting it while we keep building is the central challenge of this role. If you're drawn to problems where the bar is exactness rather than approximation, this is that kind of problem.

The second is breadth across two countries. You'll drive payroll initiatives in both Canada and the United States. That means CRA remittances, T4s, ROEs and provincial variation on one side, and federal, state and local US payroll taxes on the other, with year-end running on both calendars. We're looking for someone who already knows payroll in at least one of those two countries and wants to go deep on the other.

Alongside payroll, you'll own our integrations portfolio: 50+ POS, HR, accounting and benefits integrations that connect Push to the rest of our customers' stacks. That work is part product, part platform and part partnership. You'll decide what we build, what we maintain, what gets rebuilt and what we sunset.

Kindly note this position is for an existing role which we are actively hiring for.

Location:

Recently the world has changed so we are changing with it. We’re embracing new ways of working and are constantly adapting our practices to ensure that wherever you are working from, you feel a part of the team and have everything you need to work comfortably. We are a remote-first company, Pushies can choose to work remotely or from our Downtown Vancouver office.

We are considering eligible candidates for this role from any location across Canada.

What you'll do

  • Set and communicate the product vision and roadmap for payroll and integrations, and get the company aligned behind it
  • Drive payroll initiatives across both Canadian and US jurisdictions, from discovery through launch and adoption
  • Own the integrations portfolio end to end, including build/maintain/refactor/sunset decisions, API and platform direction.
  • Talk to customers regularly. Understand how they run payroll day to day, where we can save them the most time, and what they want next
  • Define the metrics that matter for payroll accuracy and integration health, and use them to make and defend decisions
  • Work day to day with design, engineering, QA, support, sales and customer success
  • Build the go-to-market plan with our customer facing teams, and make sure launches land with customers rather than just shipping

What success looks like in your first six months

  • Month 1-2: You know the payroll product end to end, well enough to explain how it works and where the biggest opportunities are. You've spoken with at least a dozen customers and spent real time with our support and implementation teams.
  • Month 3-4: You've published a roadmap for payroll and integrations that leadership, engineering and go-to-market all recognize as the plan, with a clear point of view on the Canada/US split.
  • Month 5-6: You've shipped something meaningful and can point to the measurable difference it made, and the integrations portfolio has a documented strategy that engineering and go-to-market both work from.

Why Push?

  • Do what you love! It’s the key to happiness. That’s why at Push we aim to create a supportive environment to help foster your passion for work, and keep you feeling energized and happy so you can do more of what you love.
  • Grow Yourself. We want to see you win in all areas. At Push, our mantra is: you will grow professionally and personally. We drive conversations around your personal and professional goals. Let’s crush it together.
  • Make an Impact. At Push, we believe everyone is born a genius, and our responsibility is to develop that genius within. Impact is our key metric - that’s why we challenge Pushies to show up as their authentic selves while creating a legacy.

Check out our About Us video:

Additional Information

At Push, we place value on different types of experiences. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve listed but you think you’re a good fit, we would still love to hear from you.

We celebrate diversity and promote equal opportunity. We appreciate what makes each of our team members different and encourage you to apply, no matter who you are or how you identify.

Push Operations welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

Please note that we use AI to screen and assess applicants for this position. Human oversight is maintained throughout the hiring process.

Salary: $120,000 - $145,000 CAD/year

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, with several of those owning a product area end to end rather than executing a defined roadmap
  • Hands-on payroll experience in Canada or the United States. You've built, run or owned payroll products or payroll operations in at least one of the two, and you understand what remittance deadlines, year-end and tax compliance actually demand. Experience in both is a strong advantage
  • Experience in B2B SaaS with real operational complexity. Products where implementation, data migration or third-party systems are part of the job
  • Comfort working with data directly. You can pull what you need, form a view, and show your work
  • Fluency with APIs and integrations at a product level. You don't need to write the code, but you should be able to hold a design conversation with an engineer and make sound tradeoffs
  • Clear, persuasive writing. Much of the influence in this role is written
  • A track record of shipping products that customers adopted, not just products that launched

Nice to have

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.excerpt: Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace.
jobs.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace. Backed by leading investors and 2,000+ customers strong, we exist to give sales teams an unfair advantage: the deepest company and people data of any platform, enriched with real-time signals, served at the right moment by intelligent agents.

Our data is the product. Building it now means building with LLMs in the pipeline, and setting the standard for when to trust them.

The Role

As Senior Data Engineer — Data Platform, you'll architect the transformation and warehouse layer that turns billions of raw records into the world's most accurate B2B dataset, and design how LLM-based extraction, enrichment, and validation run inside it as production infrastructure.

You make the architecture calls: model design and materialisation, warehouse cost and performance, orchestration patterns the team builds on, and the rule-vs-LLM standard for every quality and enrichment step. You know when a dbt test does the job, when an LLM check is needed, and when both belong together.

This is hands-on senior engineering with sharp architecture judgement. You write the reference implementation, then the team builds on it.

What You'll Own

  • LLM-in-the-pipeline architecture — the patterns for extraction, enrichment, entity resolution, and semantic validation over millions of records a day: structured outputs, retries, human-review fallbacks, and the abstractions others reuse

  • Eval harnesses — design the labelled sets, scorers, judge calibration, and regression suites that gate every prompt or model change; own precision/recall targets per check

  • The rule-vs-LLM standard — deterministic checks (dbt tests, data contracts, SQL) wherever structure allows; LLMs only where semantic judgement is needed; codified so the team can apply it without you

  • Cost and drift — token budgets per pipeline, model routing (cheap models for classification, stronger ones for hard cases), drift detection on vendor updates, and the token math behind the ceilings

  • Observability — every LLM call logged with prompt version, model, cost, latency, and decision, alongside pipeline alerting that surfaces problems before they cascade

  • Warehouse and transformation architecture — dbt layers that encode real business logic; Snowflake performance, clustering, materialisation, and cost over billions of rows

  • Orchestration and infrastructure — Airflow patterns for recovery and cost-aware scheduling; AWS infrastructure as code

  • Matching and deduplication — embeddings and retrieval patterns for company and people entity resolution across 13 markets

  • Cross-functional voice — technical voice for the platform in architecture decisions with sourcing, data quality, product, and analytics

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • 5+ years building production data platforms in business-critical environments, with architecture you've owned end to end and 2+ years experience with Snowflake

  • Worked with billions of rows — you know what breaks at that scale and how to design pipelines and checks that don't

  • Shipped LLMs inside data pipelines as production systems — extraction, enrichment, or validation with structured outputs, versioned prompts, and labelled eval sets. You can show the repo

  • Designed eval harnesses others depend on — scorers, labelled sets, judge calibration, regression suites; you can talk through what they caught and what they missed

  • Sharp judgement on rules vs. LLMs — you reach for a dbt test or SQL first, defend the call either way, and have codified the standard for a team

  • Expert Python and SQL — production-grade, performance-aware, comfortable at very large scale

  • Expert dbt and Snowflake — modular transformation layers with real business logic; warehouse design, query optimisation, clustering, RBAC, cost at scale

  • Extensive Airflow — orchestration, dependency management, recovery patterns, cost optimisation in production

  • Solid AWS — S3, Lambda, Glue, ECS, RDS

  • AI coding tools are how you work — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, daily, with real shipped work to show for it

  • Architecture judgement and a product mindset — when to refactor, optimise, ship, or redesign; you care how data quality lands with customers, not just uptime

Highly Valued

  • Eval frameworks (Braintrust, Promptfoo, Inspect) and LLM tracing (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)

  • Embeddings, vector search, or fuzzy matching for entity resolution at scale

  • Fine-tuning or distilling small models to replace expensive LLM calls

  • dbt Cloud and CI/CD for data pipelines

  • Spark or PySpark; streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Snowpipe Streaming)

  • B2B data: firmographics, people data, company registries

  • Data privacy and compliance (GDPR, SOC2, CCPA)

How We Build

Firmable is an AI-native organisation. AI coding tools, automated testing, and AI-assisted review are how we work by default. Every LLM check ships with a labelled eval set, measured precision/recall, and a prompt version you can roll back. Every LLM call in production is logged from day one; retrofitting later is not the plan.

We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. There are no fixed hours and no handholding. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why This Role

  • LLMs as production infrastructure — not a demo, not a notebook; models making millions of decisions a day on data customers pay for, and you set how they ship

  • Greenfield architecture — eval harnesses, drift detection, cost controls, and the rule-vs-LLM standard for the warehouse are largely unbuilt; you'll architect them

  • Scale that matters — billions of rows, 13 markets, and a dataset nobody else has

  • Small team, massive leverage — your architecture reaches every Firmable customer, every day

  • Competitive base + meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward

Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

Ready to architect the AI-native data platform behind the world's smartest B2B sales intelligence platform? Apply now — let's talk!

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



À propos du Rôle :

Notre équipe est en pleine croissance et nous recherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) principal(e) en sécurité des produits pour analyser en profondeur nos produits de point de terminaison, trouver des failles de conception et d'implémentation, et aider nos ingénieurs produits à résoudre les problèmes et à livrer du code sécurisé. Si vous aimez décortiquer des applications Linux pour comprendre leur fonctionnement et trouver des failles de sécurité ; si vous souhaitez réellement participer à la correction des failles plutôt que de simplement les signaler en espérant que tout se règle – nous voulons vous entendre !


Ce que vous ferez :

  • Rejoindre des équipes de projet travaillant sur des améliorations de produits et de nouveaux produits en tant qu'expert(e) et conseiller(ère) en sécurité, en influençant la conception et les capacités de nos produits de protection des points de terminaison de classe mondiale, avec un accent sur les capteurs de point de terminaison
  • Créer et mettre à jour des modèles de menaces pour aider à orienter les décisions en matière de sécurité
  • Lire et examiner le code source des applications à la recherche de failles et de vulnérabilités de sécurité ; vous aurez des outils pour vous aider, mais vous irez plus loin que ce que les outils peuvent faire
  • Penser comme un pirate informatique et attaquer des applications de point de terminaison avec des composants noyau, principalement avant leur mise en production ; encore une fois, vous aurez des outils pour vous aider, mais vous ferez plus que ce que les outils peuvent accomplir
  • Travailler avec les développeurs pour les aider à comprendre les problèmes, les risques, les faiblesses de conception, etc. et trouver de bonnes solutions
  • Créer des outils et des automatisations pour faciliter votre travail, celui de votre équipe et celui des développeurs
  • Valider et reproduire certains types de rapports de programme de primes aux bogues, et rechercher des problèmes similaires dans les applications concernées

Ce dont vous aurez besoin :

  • 10 ans ou plus d'expérience en ingénierie, idéalement en sécurité
  • Expérience en programmation ou en évaluation de la sécurité d'applications C/C++ pour Linux
  • Maîtrise des composants internes des systèmes et des fonctionnalités de sécurité pour Linux
  • Aisance avec les considérations de simultanéité dans les applications multi-fils
  • Compréhension des implications de sécurité de la conteneurisation et de la virtualisation
  • Une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les produits logiciels sont créés et livrés dans des environnements de type Agile/DevOps – suffisamment pour entretenir une relation de travail positive avec les ingénieurs produits (une expérience en développement de produits logiciels est un atout majeur, mais n'est pas obligatoire)
  • Une solide compréhension des faiblesses logicielles courantes qui affectent les applications de point de terminaison et client/serveur ; vous serez à leur recherche, vous devez les reconnaître lorsque vous les voyez et être en mesure d'aider les ingénieurs produits à les comprendre et à les corriger
  • Aisance à collaborer avec des équipes techniques : poser des questions techniques, remettre en question les hypothèses, obtenir ou fournir du contexte pour les décisions, etc.
  • Expérience avérée dans l'utilisation des technologies d'IA pour améliorer la prise de décision, rationaliser les flux de travail et les processus, améliorer l'efficacité et favoriser les résultats commerciaux

Points bonus:

  • Programmation en Rust et Go
  • Expérience avec des débogueurs tels que Ghidra, IDA Pro ou d'autres outils similaires
  • Expérience dans le développement et la maintenance d'automatisations pour les tâches de sécurité des applications
  • Expérience dans le développement et l'utilisation de modèles de menaces, notamment avec STRIDE
  • Expérience en tests de pénétration d'applications, surtout si elle inclut des tests sur des paquets d'installation et des méthodes de contournement des contrôles

Join our community of professionals shaping the future of clean energy, where every project reflects our promise of Solar Done Right.

Fleet Manager

Full-Time | Remote | $75,000 Annually

About This Role

SpartanX is seeking an experienced, highly organized Fleet Manager to oversee company vehicles supporting our residential solar operations across multiple markets.

This position is responsible for managing fleet inventory, vehicle assignments, maintenance, repairs, registrations, insurance coordination, and overall fleet performance. The Fleet Manager will work closely with Field Operations, Human Resources, Finance, and company leadership to ensure vehicles are properly maintained, cost-effective, compliant, and available to support business needs.

We're looking for someone who can manage a growing fleet, identify opportunities to reduce expenses, and maintain accountability across geographically distributed teams.

What You'll Do

Fleet Operations & Vehicle Management

  • Oversee daily fleet operations across multiple U.S. markets.
  • Maintain accurate records of company vehicles, assigned drivers, locations, and vehicle status.
  • Coordinate vehicle assignments, transfers, replacements, and returns.
  • Manage vehicle acquisition and disposal processes in coordination with leadership.
  • Monitor vehicle utilization and recommend adjustments based on operational needs.
  • Coordinate vehicle availability for new hires, transfers, and market expansion.
  • Establish and maintain consistent fleet management procedures.

Maintenance & Repairs

  • Coordinate preventive maintenance, inspections, and vehicle repairs.
  • Track maintenance schedules, mileage, and service history.
  • Work with dealerships, repair facilities, and fleet service providers.
  • Minimize vehicle downtime through proactive maintenance and timely repairs.
  • Review repair estimates and coordinate approvals according to company procedures.
  • Identify recurring maintenance concerns and recommend cost-effective solutions.
  • Monitor vehicle condition and ensure fleet assets remain safe and operational.

Fleet Compliance & Driver Accountability

  • Maintain current vehicle registrations, inspections, and required documentation.
  • Coordinate fleet insurance records, claims, and accident reporting.
  • Work with Human Resources to verify driver eligibility and required documentation.
  • Monitor compliance with company vehicle policies and applicable regulations.
  • Coordinate vehicle recovery and reassignment following employee separations.
  • Track vehicle-related incidents, damages, and policy concerns.
  • Escalate safety or compliance issues to appropriate leadership.

Vendor & Expense Management

  • Manage relationships with fleet management companies, dealerships, maintenance providers, and other vendors.
  • Review fleet-related invoices, maintenance expenses, and operating costs.
  • Monitor fuel expenses, mileage, vehicle utilization, and repair trends.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary fleet expenditures.
  • Assist with fleet budgeting, expense forecasting, and cost reporting.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and recommend improvements.
  • Support negotiations for vehicle services and fleet-related agreements.

Reporting & Cross-Department Coordination

  • Maintain accurate fleet records within company systems.
  • Provide regular reports on vehicle inventory, assignments, maintenance, expenses, and utilization.
  • Coordinate with Field Operations regarding vehicle availability and operational requirements.
  • Work with Human Resources and Onboarding on vehicle assignments for new employees.
  • Partner with Finance regarding fleet expenses, invoices, and budgeting.
  • Identify fleet-related operational risks and communicate concerns to leadership.
  • Support fleet planning as SpartanX expands into additional markets.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in fleet management, fleet operations, transportation management, or a related role
  • Experience managing vehicles across multiple locations or geographic markets.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle maintenance, repair coordination, and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and controlling fleet expenses.
  • Knowledge of vehicle registrations, insurance coordination, and fleet compliance requirements.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
  • Experience with fleet management software, tracking systems, and reporting tools.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business applications.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate across multiple departments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing fleets for construction, solar, utilities, telecommunications, or other field-service organizations.
  • Experience with vehicle acquisition, leasing, and disposal.
  • Familiarity with GPS tracking, telematics, and fuel management systems.
  • Experience supporting a geographically distributed workforce.
  • Experience developing fleet policies and cost-control procedures.

Schedule

Primarily Monday–Friday, with occasional after-hours or weekend availability based on operational needs.

What We Offer

  • $75,000 annual salary
  • Full-time position
  • Remote work environment
  • Opportunity to manage and improve fleet operations across multiple markets
  • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization
  • Collaborative environment working directly with Field Operations and company leadership

Why SpartanX?

Our field teams depend on reliable transportation to keep projects moving. When vehicles are unavailable, poorly maintained, or improperly assigned, operations slow down.

As our Fleet Manager, you'll be responsible for keeping our fleet organized, operational, and cost-effective while supporting the continued growth of SpartanX.

If you're a proactive fleet professional who understands that vehicle management is about more than keeping track of keys and maintenance schedules, we want to hear from you.

Solar Done Right.

Sales Focus

  • Building new relationships with distributors and key industry players

  • Managing and growing existing accounts

  • Generating and managing a strong sales pipeline

Nasz Klient, międzynarodowa firma z sektora energii odnawialnej, poszukuje Project Development Managera, który poprowadzi rozwój projektów wiatrowych, fotowoltaicznych oraz systemów magazynowania energii (BESS) na terenie całej Polski.

Obowiązki

  • Prowadzenie wszystkich działań rozwojowych dla projektów wiatrowych, PV oraz BESS (greenfield, mid‑stage, mature) — od wczesnej fazy rozwoju do etapu RTB — we współpracy z wewnętrznymi interesariuszami oraz deweloperami zewnętrznymi.

  • Przygotowywanie i zarządzanie harmonogramami oraz budżetami projektów, zapewniając terminową realizację poszczególnych etapów we współpracy z odpowiednimi działami firmy.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku międzynarodowym lub w dużej firmie energetycznej będzie dodatkowym atutem.

  • Wysoka znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie).

The Partner Manager is responsible for developing and maintaining a strong and productive relationship with Flash service partners. It is a forward-looking, leadership-driven role focused on improvement, operational excellence, and enabling scalable high-quality service delivery.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Relationship Management – Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with partners, acting as the primary point of contact between them and internal teams. Effective relationship management ensures smooth communication, faster issue resolution, and long-term partnership stability.

  • Contract Negotiation – Lead negotiations on pricing and terms to secure cost-effective, favorable agreements that protect the company's interests while enabling partner success. Proactively manage contracts across their lifecycle to avoid risks and ensure value.

  • Evaluation and Performance Monitoring – Continuously assess partner performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs. Early identification of gaps enables proactive interventions, mitigating service disruptions and supporting continuous improvement.

  • Quality Assurance – Ensure partners comply with required quality standards and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular audits and drive corrective actions to reduce risk exposure and maintain service integrity.

  • Cost Management – Analyze partner cost structures, identify inefficiencies, and lead cost-reduction strategies. This is critical to maintaining competitiveness and supporting sustainable growth.

  • Supply Chain Optimization – Collaborate with partners to enhance logistics, inventory management, and overall supply chain performance, directly impacting customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Act as a strategic liaison between partners and internal teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and seamless operational execution.

  • Travel – Able to provide onsite support for business reviews, training, auditing, warehouse relocations, and new partner setup.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Language – Fluency in English is required.

  • Leadership – Essential for driving performance, leading change, and fostering accountability in partner relationships. Effective leadership ensures partners remain aligned with the company's goals and culture.

  • Analytical Thinking – Critical for turning data into actionable insights. The ability to identify patterns and performance gaps supports informed decisions and continuous service optimization.

  • Problem Solving – Enables the Partner Manager to quickly address operational or contractual issues, minimizing impact on service delivery and maintaining customer trust.

  • Negotiation & Communication – Strong negotiation secures beneficial terms, while clear communication ensures expectations are understood and met by all parties. This helps build long-term, transparent partnerships.

  • Technical Proficiency – Familiarity with relevant systems and tools (both internal and partner platforms) allows for efficient issue tracking, reporting, and collaboration, streamlining daily operations and reducing friction.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Advanced English – C1.

  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree from an accredited educational institution, focused on logistics, business, or related areas.

  • Extremely proficient in Microsoft applications and the use of online- based tools and programs.

  • Able to conduct financial data analysis as required to validate charges, expenses, and business operational profitability.

  • Previous leadership experience, preferably in the areas of Logistics/Transportation/Inventory Management.

  • General knowledge of Trade Compliance, Import, and export regulations.

  • Knowledge of logistics and supply chain order management and WMS systems.

jobs.description:
Type:: Full-time

Location: Remote, with a preference for candidates located in NY, TX, MD, or GA

Compensation: $140,000 - $180,000

Job Level: Director/VP (depending on experience)

ABOUT LEMONTREE

There are more food pantries in the US than there are McDonalds, but most families facing hunger don’t take that help. That’s why we started Lemontree–because it makes no sense for our neighbors to go hungry when there’s free food around the corner. We’ve helped one million households access the free food in their communities by bringing technology + empathy to the experience of food assistance. Learn more about us at .

Our Values

Service Over Self

We put the mission — helping people find food — ahead of ego, credit, or agenda. That means caring for the people we serve and the team around us, and going the extra mile when it makes a real difference. We're here for the work itself and what it makes possible for others.

Ownership

We get shit done and we carry our piece so the whole team can move forward. When we make a mistake, we name it early and openly, because a problem we've owned out loud is one we can fix together. In a growing org, this kind of autonomy & accountability is how we do big things with a small team.

CuriosityWe don’t take anything for granted. We stay curious about our users and ourselves. We stay humble enough to accept that there’s always room to improve. We stay ready to change course when the evidence points somewhere new. The plan we have today is a strong draft, but we’ll always need to adapt to a changing world. We'd rather ask the better question and adjust than defend a stale answer.

THE POSITION

Lemontree is looking for a Head of Product& Technology that will partner with the Executive Director to own and evolve our platform strategy to scale our impact. Since 2020, we’ve grown from a simple helpline into a platform that serves thousands of families, partners, and volunteers daily. What we need now is someone who can shepherd us to the next level, bringing rigor and direction to how we evolve: sharper prioritization, better use of our data, and clearer decision-making & process around where we invest our resources. Every decision we make should align with our strategic anchors:

  1. User-centered
  2. Hospitality in every interaction
  3. Built for scale

This is a hands-on leadership role with high trust and high agency, reporting to the Executive Director. You'll be the person setting product direction and leading the charge to move it forward, partnering with an engineering agency on execution and collaborating closely across our broader Lemontree team. While product ownership is the focus, this is a multi-disciplinary position that combines product management, data analysis, and technical leadership to build toward stability and scalability. If you like operating with real autonomy and are motivated to take things from 1 → 100, this role will suit you.

What You'll Do

Drive technical leadership that delivers a reliable, joyful, scalable user experience for neighbors looking for food assistance.

  • Serve as a credible technical voice in conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and feasibility.
  • Direct our engineering agency, translating product priorities into well-scoped technical work and holding a high bar for what ships.
  • Oversee third party services that support our product, including setting up integrations, managing billing, negotiating nonprofit discounts, etc.

Own a product roadmap that increases the breadth & depth of our impact, aligned with our organizational strategy.

  • Partner with CEO & senior leadership to shape overall strategy & product direction. Rather than making every single product decision, you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow-through.
  • Define and prioritize product roadmap, ensuring usability, reliability, and scalability. We don't expect you to arrive with all the answers. We do expect you to ask good questions.
  • Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle management — from planning, requirement gathering, and design to deployment and maintenance. Maintain a reliable source of truth for priorities, roadmap status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and open questions.

Lead our data & evaluation strategy to inform how our product evolves and how we measure our impact.

  • Lead our data strategy. We collect meaningful signals from the families and partners we serve, and we want someone who can turn it into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect.
  • Support teammates who are seeking answers to questions that inform their work.

Support cross-team communication & organizational decision-making infrastructure.

  • Build the cross-functional trust that makes great product work possible. Collaborate with all levels of the organization, and help the team stay close to the families we serve.
  • Bring structure to how we work. Improve how product decisions get made, how teams communicate across functions, and how we plan, without adding process for its own sake.
  • Communicate product vision and strategy to internal & external stakeholders. Make priorities, assumptions, and decision rationale visible and understandable across the organization.

Who You Are

  • You have 5–10 years of product & tech experience, including time owning the product function at an early stage small/mid-sized organization AND responsibility for aligning multiple functions around those goals (engineering, customer success, comms, etc).
  • You're energized by taking something that already works and making it even better. You’re genuinely motivated by solving problems, big and small, for other people–not just the flashy wins.
  • You’re a player-coach comfortable working on small teams, getting your hands dirty as the only product/tech person, and surfacing clarity out of ambiguity.
  • You know how to create leverage through modern AI tooling, strong technical judgment, and processes that support organizational health. You’re familiar with AI-assisted product development and know how to use AI coding tools to vibecode & build prototypes. We retain an engineering agency, but we’re looking to increase our internal technical capacity to speed up the process between idea → deployment.
  • You understand how to work with data–analytics experience is a plus. You know the right questions to ask and how to get from a number to a decision.

Job Summary:

The Customer Success Manager is responsible for building strong, long-term relationships with customers and ensuring they realize maximum value from Shiji’s hospitality technology solutions. This role drives customer engagement, product adoption, and sustained value by supporting customers throughout the post implementation lifecycle. As the primary
advocate for our customers, the Customer Success Manager delivers strategic guidance, clear communication, and a deep understanding of each customer’s operational, and business needs to help them achieve measurable outcomes.

This role requires balancing product knowledge, business acumen, and interpersonal intelligence to navigate complex customer environments, build trust across diverse stakeholders, and ensure a positive and successful customer journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain deep, long-term relationships with key stakeholders at both the property and corporate levels across the Americas, serving as the trusted advisor and primary point of contact to ensure alignment between Shiji’s technology and the customer’s operational goals.
  • Lead the formal transition of clients from the implementation phase into long-term success, coordinating with internal Implementation and Support teams to ensure a smooth handoff while acting as the internal customer advocate to drive adoption, product understanding, and value realization.
  • Perform regular, data-backed business reviews, health checks, and strategic planning sessions to monitor customer satisfaction and progress against success metrics, proactively identifying improvement opportunities and adoption gaps to recommend improvements and best practices.
  • Proactively identify accounts facing operational, technical or adoption risks and develop strategic recovery and stabilization plans to prevent churn and support renewal readiness.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for customers, managing issues with professionalism, composure, and empathy, while coordinating resolution with appropriate internal teams to keep the client informed and reassured.
  • Help customers differentiate between product limitations, process gaps, configuration challenges, and internal communication issues, facilitating clear and constructive problem-solving.
  • Act as a bridge between the Americas market and Shiji’s global Product organization, sharing insights, trends, and recurring challenges to influence product enhancements and prioritize localized requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Support, Implementation and Technical Account Management teams to ensure customers receive the appropriate level of technical and operational support throughout the lifecycle.
  • Lead customer meetings, executive business reviews, and best-practice sessions (onsite and virtual) to reinforce value realization and strengthen long-term partnership and engagement.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Effectiveness in this role is measured by the tangible value delivered to clients and the strength of partnerships built across the Americas. After the initial ramp-up period, success is demonstrated through consistent delivery of the following outcomes:

  • Clients actively adopt and utilize solutions to achieve their operational and financial goals.
  • High client retention is maintained, with renewals secured in a timely and seamless manner.
  • Strong, trusted relationships are established at both the property and corporate levels, with recognition as a strategic partner.
  • Risks and challenges are identified early, with proactive solutions implemented before impacting the client experience.
  • Clients demonstrate satisfaction through ongoing engagement, advocacy, and willingness to serve as references.

What You’ll Bring (knowledge, skills, and abilities):

  • Minimum three (3) years of professional experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client facing role within a SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on experience in the hospitality industry, with strong practical knowledge of hotel technology ecosystems such as enterprise Property Management Systems (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), and Global/Distribution CRS platforms, as well as modern cloud-based PMS/POS architectures and their integration frameworks.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English, with superior written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, lead customer discussions, and deliver effective presentations.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the ability to navigate interpersonal dynamics, manage stakeholder relationships, and remain calm, objective, and solution-focused in high- pressure or escalation scenarios.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret system data and usage metrics to generate insights that help customers optimize operations and outcomes.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives, manage competing demands and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional, collaborative teams.
  • Ability to guide customer conversations constructively, align stakeholders on solutions, and support decision-making.

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related field

Success Factors (Core Competencies):

  • Relationship-building and stakeholder influence across both property and corporate levels.
  • Strategic alignment of technology solutions with the operational and financial goals of the customer.
  • Proactive problem-solving and risk mitigation to maintain seamless customer experience.
  • Clear and concise communication, capable of connecting technical details with practical business outcomes.
  • Ownership and accountability for driving product adoption, securing renewals, and ensuring overall customer satisfaction.
  • Adaptability and resilience to manage multiple accounts in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment.

​​​​​​​Travel Requirements:

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally; valid passport required.

Shiji Group provides software solutions and services for the hospitality, food service, retail and entertainment industries, ranging from hotel management solutions, to food and beverage and retail systems, payment gateways, data management, online distribution and more.

Founded in 1998 as a network solutions provider for hotels, and later changed to a software provider for the whole consumer market, Shiji Group today comprises 5,000 employees in 80+ subsidiaries and brands, serving over 91,000 hotels, 200,000 restaurants and 600,000 retail outlets.

Shiji is committed to connecting the global business of hospitality. We provide an integrated suite of technological solutions that empower hotel, retail, food, and entertainment companies to better connect with their guests.

If this sounds like you, read on.

ABOUT BREAKTHROUGH ACADEMY

Breakthrough Academy specializes in helping high-performing entrepreneurs in the contracting industry grow their businesses by implementing excellent operational systems into their companies. We believe in the unlimited potential of entrepreneurship and help our Members (customers) break through barriers and take their businesses to the next level.

Our proprietary training program brings systemization to a contracting company's operations, develops an entrepreneur's core business skills, and holds accountability to goals through a clear business plan.

Breakthrough Academy is now 11 years old and evolving rapidly, with over 750 business owners developing inside our program, and an incredible team of 55+ individuals who make an impact on our members every single day. We’re now entering one of the most exciting chapters in our company's history. We have a proven market, a strong brand, an incredible community of Members, and a tremendous opportunity ahead of us. We’re looking for the right leader to help us build on that foundation and unlock the next level of revenue growth.

Because of this, we are looking for our first ever Chief Revenue Officer, an executive who will play a defining role in shaping the future of Breakthrough Academy.

This is where you come in.

THIS IS FOR YOU IF:

  • You've built and scaled sophisticated B2B digital marketing engines in a $10M-50M business that consistently generated qualified demand, improved marketing ROI, and fuelled sustainable revenue growth.
  • You have deep expertise in B2B digital marketing and know how to turn marketing investment into predictable, profitable revenue growth.
  • You have a track record of improving ROI by making smart commercial decisions about where to invest, what to optimize, and what to stop doing.
  • You have experience evaluating and scaling multiple growth channels, including digital acquisition, partnerships, events, and other strategic growth opportunities.
  • You have built high-performing digital marketing teams by creating a culture of ownership, clarity, urgency, collaboration, and measurable results
  • You know how to build marketing strategies that create predictable pipelines, not just campaigns that generate activity.
  • You have successfully unified Sales and Marketing under one commercial strategy, creating alignment, accountability, and shared ownership of revenue growth.
  • You thrive in founder-led businesses where there is significant opportunity to shape strategy, build enterprise value, and directly influence the company's next stage of growth.

IN THE ROLE, YOU WILL:

  • Own and optimize Breakthrough Academy's marketing system - improving customer acquisition strategy, channel performance, and return on marketing investment
  • Develop and execute a scalable B2B demand generation strategy across digital channels, partnerships, events, customer referrals and emerging growth opportunities
  • Bring strategic discipline to our growth investments by identifying the highest-leverage opportunities across marketing, channels, partnerships, and market expansion
  • Transform our approach to demand generation by evaluating our current growth engine and building a more predictable, scalable path to revenue.
  • Shape our go-to-market strategy by refining our Ideal Customer Profile, positioning, messaging, and approach to reaching business owners across North America.
  • Create a data driven system that improves visibility into acquisition performance, conversion, forecasting, and revenue outcomes.
  • Unify Marketing and Sales around a shared revenue strategy, creating alignment between market demand, pipeline generation, and customer growth
  • Identify new opportunities for growth through strategic partnerships, events, pricing, packaging, and additional revenue opportunities
  • Lead and develop the VP of Marketing and Director of Sales, creating clarity, accountability, and a high-performance culture across the revenue organization.
  • Partner directly with the CEO to shape Breakthrough Academy's next phase of revenue growth, making the strategic decisions that will define the future of the company

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • 10+ years of deep expertise building and scaling B2B digital marketing teams, with a proven ability to turn marketing investment into measurable revenue growth.
  • Previous experience as a VP Marketing, VP Growth, VP Revenue, CRO or equivalent commercial leadership role within a $15M-$50M+ B2B organization.
  • A proven track record of scaling B2B customer acquisition through digital marketing, demand generation, and multi-channel growth strategies.
  • Experience owning significant marketing budgets and making strategic investment decisions tied directly to revenue outcomes, ROI, and business growth.
  • Experience building and optimizing go-to-market strategies, including positioning, ICP development, channel strategy, and market expansion.
  • Experience leading both Sales and Marketing functions, with accountability for revenue performance and commercial alignment.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and leading leaders within a high growth organization.
  • Prior experience scaling a founder-led or entrepreneurial business where strategy, structure, and operating discipline needed to evolve alongside growth.

THE BENEFITS

  • Own one of the most important growth opportunities in Breakthrough Academy's history, shaping the commercial strategy that will define our next stage of revenue scale.
  • Partner directly with the CEO and leadership team, having a meaningful voice in company strategy, growth priorities, and the decisions that shape the future of the business.
  • Join a company that has built remarkable momentum, averaging 72% year-over-year growth for the past decade, serving 750+ business owners across North America, and entering its next phase of growth.
  • Have the opportunity to build a world-class revenue organization, combining strong existing foundations with your own strategic vision and leadership.
  • Create measurable impact every day by helping entrepreneurs across North America build stronger businesses, improve their livelihoods, and create more opportunities for their teams and families.
  • Be part of a company where execution quality directly shows up in real business outcomes for our Members.
  • Work alongside an ambitious leadership team that values ownership, excellence, continuous improvement, and doing meaningful work together.
  • Enjoy a highly competitive executive compensation package that includes a strong base salary, performance based bonus structure, and long term equity participation through stock options.
  • Enjoy amazing travel perks and company events in epic locations - our team events this year ranged from the warm beaches of Baja Mexico to the serene mountains Canmore Alberta.

If you're an experienced revenue leader looking for an opportunity to architect the next stage of growth inside a profitable, founder-led business with tremendous momentum, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY:At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases.
jobs.description:
COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:


As Exec. Director, Biostatistics, this individual leads the conduct and analysis of all BioCryst-sponsored clinical studies from Phase I to Phase IV as well as selected non-clinical studies. The role requires technical expertise as well as vendor management capabilities. The individual in this role is responsible for the appropriate use of statistical thinking and methods and conformance to principles of GCP, as applicable to biostatistics and programming. S/he is also responsible for the identification, evaluation, and implementation of new processes and technologies related to biostatistics and programming as well as outsourcing strategy, in alignment with the goals of Biostatistics & Data Science.


S/he may act as project statistician for an individual project. Performance in this role relies on an extensive experience base in study design, regulatory strategy and programming, sound judgment to plan and accomplish goals, and an ability to lead and direct the work of others. A wide scope of creativity and latitude is expected. and direct the work of others. A wide scope of creativity and latitude is expected.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Responsible for Biostatistics support of BioCryst-sponsored clinical studies as well as selected non-clinical studies and Biostatistics support of Medical Affairs.
  • Ensures the relevance and adequacy of statistical methods employed in BioCryst-sponsored clinical development activities and selected nonclinical studies.
  • Ensures conformance to relevant regulatory guidelines and Good Clinical Practice.
  • Ensures that Biostatistics effectively contributes to the formulation of clinical development strategies as regards optimal development program and study design.
  • Responsible for Biostatistics oversight of CRO/contract staff for performance of outsourced operational activities. Reviews and approves contracts, work orders, and invoices within grant of authority.
  • Act as project statistician for an individual project.
  • Participation in FDA and other regulatory agency meetings as the Company’s spokesperson for biostatistical topics.
  • Thinks outside of the regulatory biostatistics box (e.g. maximum learning from phase 2 experiments regardless of pre-specified SAP, experience in Phase 3b/4 design and analysis to maximize a product’s life cycle).
  • Participation in organization-wide process definition, creation, and implementation with a continuous focus on efficiency and productivity enhancement.
  • Definition, monitoring, and evaluation of relevant performance metrics.
  • Author/ reviewer of relevant sections of all critical documents required to support development of Company’s products including clinical study protocols, statistical analysis plans, data management plans, regulatory briefing documents, regulatory dossiers such as NDAs and MAAs, responses to regulatory questions, scientific abstracts and manuscripts.
  • Responsible for accuracy of data included in public corporate communications of BioCryst clinical trial results, including press releases, slide presentations, SEC filings, scientific meeting abstracts, and published manuscripts. Responsible for monitoring quality audit process for those communications.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to technical or regulatory audiences, and to broader audiences in a nontechnical manner without loss of rigor.

• All other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Ph.D. in Biostatistics (or related field) with at least 12 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry, 10 or more years’ experience in the design, analysis and interpretation of clinical trials or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Deep understanding of SAS programming is sufficient to provide oversight of statistical programming and ability to program as needed. Management experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
  • NDA filing experience: key contributor to one or more successful product approvals.
  • Proven expertise with the disciplines, practices and procedures that pertain to biostatistics, programming, and clinical data management, including development and accountability for relevant quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the clinical development process and relevant regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Experience with Data Monitoring Committees and\or study steering committees.
  • Takes a hands-on approach (e.g. will do analyses him/herself when necessary).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven team player with ability to work well in a collegial environment: willing to challenge the status quo.
  • Experience with European and Japanese regulatory agencies.
  • Formal expertise and experience in Bayesian statistics as well as frequentist statistics.
  • Experience supporting medical affairs and post-marketing studies is an added benefit.
  • Flexible scheduling and ability to travel internationally.
  • “Small-company attitude” that embraces change within a high-risk environment.
  • Responsiveness and ability to prioritize effectively.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. The manager may assign additional responsibilities and assignments from time to time.

Data Sciences Staffing Solutions, DSSS, is a unit within IQVIA that provides our sponsors with fully embedded resources through a Functional Service Provider (FSP) partnership. This means you get all the benefits of working for an industry leading global CRO while collaborating with expert sponsor teams. These sponsor clients include world class pharmaceutical and biotech companies offering you unique opportunities to influence the future of medicine and advance therapies to market.

Job Summary:

The Principal Biostatistician is responsible for providing full range statistical support for drug development based on real world evidence (RWE).

Additional Benefits:

  • Home-based remote working opportunities
  • Work/life balance as well as flexible schedules.
  • Collaborating with motivated, high-performance, statistical and research teams
  • Technical training and tailored development curriculum
  • Research opportunities that match your unique skillset
  • Promising career trajectory
  • Job stability: long-term engagements and re-deployment opportunities
  • Focus on bringing new therapies to market rather than project budgets and change orders.
  • Experience with regulatory submissions.
  • Engaging, fast-paced environment.
  • Good work-life balance.

Job Requirements:

  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams to establish project goals and timelines.
  • Serves as statistical lead and represents Biometrics on health outcomes and epidemiology studies.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for RWE/HEOR/HTA research design, methodologies, data sources, analytic techniques, and reporting.
  • Writes statistical analysis plans.
  • Provides strategic and tactical support for cross-functional RWE development for regulators, payers, and clinicians.
  • Leverages administrative claims, electronic medical records, registries, or other real-world data and recommends optimal analysis.
  • Selects and implements appropriate analytical methods including statistical models or machine learning models to align with overall business objectives.
  • Develops high quality study protocols, statistical analysis plans, study reports, and other study documents.
  • Identifies innovation opportunities for the use of RWD.
  • Establishes effective communication with various internal stakeholders to understand and support the strategy for when and how to use RWD.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of data accuracy and integrity by implementing rigorous quality control processes throughout the data handling and analysis phases.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new requirements and efficiently handle ad-hoc requests.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • In-depth knowledge of RWE databases, including large administrative claims data, EMR, disease registries, and clinical trial data.
  • Demonstrated ability in evaluation and development of RWE from conceptualization through application.
  • Familiarity with LOINC codes, reimbursement and lab data interpretation, and ability to implement surrogate variable algorithms (e.g., phenotype definitions, proxies for clinical endpoints)
  • Ability to execute statistical analysis plans using advanced programming techniques to perform detailed and complex analyses relevant to real-world evidence.
  • Ability to effectively interpret and communicate research results to internal and external audiences.
  • Understanding of ICH GCP and E9 as well as general knowledge of industry practices and standard
  • Knowledge of global regulatory and HTA requirements for RWE
  • Excellent organizational skills and proven ability to effectively lead multiple projects to successful completion.
  • SME-level proficiency in SAS programming tailored to handle complex inclusion and exclusion criteria, conduct propensity score matching, and develop outcome metrics.

Required Education and Experience: (Minimal acceptable level of education, work experience, and competency)

  • Ph.D. in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field with 5+ years of industry experience.
  • Experience leading secondary data analysis, including medical claims, electronic medical records, chart reviews, and registries.
  • Solid hands-on experience as Project statistician with real-world data, including EMR/EHR and claims datasets (e.g., Humedica, Optum, MarketScan, CMS, Komodo, Truveta, TrinetX, etc.)
  • Fluency in LOA, mock TFLs, protocol and SAP
  • Experience in cost analysis and healthcare resource utilization (HCRU) evaluation using RWD
  • Experience with CDISC ADAM datasets.
  • Extensive working experience with stakeholders such as medical affairs and health economics

Preferred but not Required Experience:

  • Understanding of payer landscape, health economic outcomes, and value demonstration frameworks
  • Exposure to regulatory submissions, HTA support.
  • Expertise in R is also valued.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Boundless is coordinating GPU compute at scale and building toward becoming a leader in AI. As an Applied AI/ML Engineer, you'll ship AI-powered products end-to-end on top of our growing GPU inference fleet — owning everything from serving low-latency inference to standing up reinforcement-learning post-training pipelines. This is a builder's role: you take an idea from prototype to production, tune it for throughput and cost on real GPUs, and iterate fast on customer and internal feedback.

You should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, navigating ambiguity, and defaulting to a strong bias for action.

What You'll Do

End-to-End AI Product Delivery: Own AI features and products from prototype through production — model selection, serving, evaluation, and iteration — shipping working software rather than research artifacts.

Inference Serving: Deploy and optimize LLM inference across the fleet using vLLM and SGLang. Tune continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization, speculative decoding, and multi-model routing to maximize throughput and minimize latency and cost per token.

RL & Post-Training Harnesses: Build and operate reinforcement-learning and post-training pipelines using slime (Megatron-LM + SGLang) and Prime Intellect (prime-rl + the Environments Hub / verifiers). This includes reward and verifier design, rollout orchestration, weight synchronization, and keeping long-running training stable.

Evaluation & Iteration: Build eval harnesses and benchmarks that measure quality, throughput, and cost together, and use them to drive fast, data-informed iteration.

Work Across the Stack: Partner with Infrastructure on GPU scheduling and fleet utilization, and with Product on what to build next and why.

Requirements

  • 3+ years shipping ML/AI systems to production
  • Hands-on experience serving LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM
  • Experience with RL / post-training methods (GRPO, PPO, DPO, or SFT), or strong adjacent experience and a clear desire to go deep here
  • Strong Python and PyTorch
  • Working understanding of GPU execution: batching, memory, and basic CUDA concepts
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity with a strong bias for action

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with slime, prime-rl, the verifiers library, or Megatron-LM
  • Distributed training experience (FSDP, TP/PP/DP parallelism)
  • Quantization (FP8/INT8), P/D disaggregation, or speculative decoding
  • Experience with verifiable inference or large-scale distributed systems
  • Kubernetes and container-based deployment
  • Familiarity with GPU fleet orchestration (Ray, SkyPilot, Slurm)

Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must include a public GitHub profile in their application.
  • The GitHub profile should demonstrate a minimum of 1 year of activity/history.
  • Applications that do not include a GitHub profile, or show insufficient activity, will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, vision (for U.S. employees; region-adjusted globally)

ABOUT XO HEALTH:

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client and TPA Onboarding:

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
  • Own the accurate setup of each group across XO’s systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
  • Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

Project Management:

  • Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
  • Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
  • Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

Client Communication:

  • Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
  • Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
  • Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group’s setup and any open items.

Playbook and Continuous Improvement:

  • Own XO’s implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
  • Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
  • Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:

Required:

  • 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
  • Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
  • Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
  • Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
  • Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
  • Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

Preferred:

  • Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
  • Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
  • PMP or similar project management credentials.

KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:

Accountability: you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

Critical Thinking: you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

Change Champion: you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

Relationships:you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

Job Description:

The Director of Retention Operations for the Reporting business unit is a strategic operations leader responsible for gross retention rate (GRR) and net retention rate (NRR) across a high-volume customer base. Reporting to the General Manager, this role consolidates customer success signal at scale, identifies churn risk and expansion opportunities across cohorts, and ensures execution of programmatic retention and growth strategies.

This is an internal, cross-functional operations role that brings discipline and scalability to retention by maintaining visibility into cohort and segment health trends, analyzing churn patterns and root causes, and ensuring that retention and expansion strategies are being executed with consistency and rigor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Consolidate customer health signals (usage trends, engagement, support incidents, expansion opportunity) from customer success teams to provide the GM with weekly visibility into account and cohort health

  • Track gross retention rate (GRR) and net retention rate (NRR) by product, segment, and cohort; conduct variance analysis to identify deterioration trends and positive momentum

  • Identify at-risk account cohorts and customers; work with customer success to develop targeted interventions and track remediation progress

  • Conduct root-cause analysis on churn trends; identify systemic issues (product, onboarding, support, pricing) and recommend operational or product improvements

  • Partner with customer success, product, and marketing to design and implement retention and expansion plays (e.g., programmatic outreach, upgrade campaigns, engagement initiatives)

  • Maintain dashboards that track GRR, NRR, churn cohorts, expansion opportunity, and other key retention metrics; provide predictive forecasts of end-of-period performance

  • Work with customer success to develop and implement escalation and resolution protocols for at-risk accounts

  • Provide regular reporting to the GM on retention performance, key drivers, and recommended actions

  • Deep understanding of the at risk accounts and the plan of attack to maintain each customer and grow GRR.

  • Identify and work to resolve issues impacting customer retention through process improvement challenges with renewal management and other CS ops related patterns.

What Success Looks Like

  • The Directorhas real-time visibility into GRR and NRR performance by segment and cohort, with clear understanding of primary churn drivers

  • At-risk cohorts are identified early (at least one quarter in advance), with documented interventions tracked to completion

  • Churn analysis is conducted systematically for all at-risk accounts; patterns are identified and communicated to product and operations

  • Retention and expansion plays are tracked against execution and adoption targets

  • GRR and NRR meet or exceed target, with measurable improvement in efficiency and speed of intervention

Required Skills & Experience

  • Seven to ten years of experience in customer success operations, retention analytics, or similar role in a high-volume B2B SaaS environment

  • Deep understanding of SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, CAC payback, churn drivers, cohort analysis) and ability to identify and investigate performance variances

  • Demonstrable experience working with programmatic or high-volume customer bases (100 plus accounts or more)

  • Strong analytical and data visualization skills; comfort with SQL, BI tools, and statistical analysis

  • Experience designing and tracking retention initiatives or campaigns at scale

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to distill complex analyses into actionable insights for leadership

  • Project management mindset: ability to manage multiple retention and expansion initiatives in parallel

Core Attributes

  • Systematic: Brings structure and process to high-volume environments; thinks in terms of cohorts and patterns, not just individual accounts.
  • Analytical: Comfortable working with large datasets; good at identifyingsignal in noise.
  • Collaborative: Partners well with customer success, product, and marketing; sees retention as a shared responsibility.
  • Execution-oriented: Focuses on results and impact; isn't satisfied until strategies are tested, tracked, and optimized.

  • Base salary: Competitive, based on experience. Bonus structure: 80 percent base,20 percent bonus tied to GRR and NRR targets for the Reporting cohort.
