jobs.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Staff AI Developer to be part of making that happen.  

 

About the Role

The Staff AI Developer builds and delivers the AI features that power Arctic Wolf Labs, working across machine learning, data science, generative AI, and agentic systems. This is a hands-on senior engineering role: you'll take significant features and components from design through production, and you'll be one of the people the team relies on to ship well.


You don't need to be a specialist in every AI discipline, but you should be comfortable working with the data science team on data science concepts, delivery mechanisms, and trade-offs across ML, generative AI, and agentic systems, enough to make sound design decisions and collaborate credibly with specialists.

Responsibilities

Design & Delivery

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems and components across ML pipelines, generative AI, and agentic workflows.
  • Turn ambiguous problems into working systems that unify heterogeneous data sources using rule-based, probabilistic, and ML-based approaches.
  • Apply best practices for secure, observable, and scalable AI systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
  • Help evaluate emerging frameworks and approaches (agentic orchestration, fine-tuning, evaluation methods) and bring recommendations to the team.
  • Build and maintain ML and data pipelines for training, deploying, and monitoring fine-tuned generative AI and machine learning models.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work with the data science team, engineering managers, product, and security operations analysts to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value.
  • Translate between disciplines, helping data scientists understand production constraints and helping partners understand what the AI solution needs.
  • Collaborate with security operations, threat researchers, and product teams to ground your work in real operational workflows and quality feedback loops.

Communication

  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and technical decisions clearly, in writing and verbally, to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write clear technical documents: design docs, architecture decision records, and status updates the team can act on.

Hands-On Engineering & Mentorship

  • Own the day-to-day engineering: write code, review PRs, debug production issues, and unblock teammates.
  • Mentor mid-level and early-career engineers, and raise the bar on code quality, testing, and operational hygiene.
  • Instrument AI quality, measure outcomes, and help close the feedback loop with operations teams.

About You

  • 6+ years building intelligent systems, distributed platforms, or AI-enhanced applications.
  • Experience designing and shipping systems that support ML, data science, generative AI, or agentic workloads, without necessarily being a deep practitioner in all of them.
  • Production experience with generative AI systems (prompt engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and some exposure to fine-tuning).
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and LLM integration patterns (e.g., AgentCore, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, or equivalent).
  • Track record of partnering with cross-functional teams (data science, product, operations) to deliver customer-facing outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong hands-on coding ability, you spend most of your time building.
  • Experience with cloud-native data services (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code / CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to cybersecurity concepts: threat detection, alert triage, risk modelling, exposure management, MITRE ATT&CK, telemetry.
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools (Spark, Flink, Kafka, Databricks).
  • Experience with ML quality measurement and evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop evaluation).
  • DevSecOps and security-first development mindset.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing . 

Security Requirements

Process Design, Experience and Change

  • Facilitate current-state and future-state workshops covering leadership, recruiter, hiring-manager and candidate experiences.

  • Produce process maps, standard operating procedures, templates, FAQs and other materials required to embed the new experience and ways of working.

Leadership, Capability and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead, coach and develop APAC solution design and implementation resources, setting clear priorities, performance expectations and professional development plans.
  • Build high-performing cross-functional teams and create accountability across direct, matrixed and project-based contributors.
  • Represent APAC in global solution design and implementation governance, sharing regional insight and helping to embed consistent standards and best practices.
  • Lead strategic initiatives and continuous-improvement programmes that advance business goals, delivery quality, scalability and client outcomes.
  • Support existing client operations with solution reviews, redesigns and new initiatives requiring specialist solution, implementation, process or change expertise.
  • Manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while maintaining quality, pace and stakeholder confidence.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Leads the APAC Solution Design and Implementation capability, which may include Solution Design Directors, Implementation Directors, Process & Change leaders, Solution Design Managers, Architects, Analysts and project-based or matrixed workstream resources. Responsibilities include workforce planning, role allocation, coaching, performance reviews, succession planning and professional growth.

  • Formal project management qualification preferred.

Experience

  • Demonstrated success designing and commercially shaping complex recruitment or professional-services solutions, preferably within an established RPO provider.
  • Strong track record leading large-scale or complex implementations and managing senior internal and external stakeholders through mobilisation and change.
  • Experience in recruitment operations leadership, process design, operating-model development, continuous improvement and technology-enabled transformation.
  • Experience with pricing, financial modelling, resource modelling and ROI analysis for complex services solutions.

  • People leadership experience, including coaching, performance management and development of specialist teams.

Capabilities and Exposure

  • Commercially astute, analytically strong and comfortable evaluating data, assumptions, risk, profitability and client value.

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

We are seeking a physician to serve as a Senior Medical Director to oversee global Phase 3 clinical trials a BLA (Biologic Licensing Application) filings. The incumbent will be primarily responsible for developing and executing an integrated clinical trial programs including protocol design and medical oversight of new or ongoing studies.  They will be responsible for obtaining scientific advisory input, work with biostatisticians for phase 3 design and analyses, support regulatory interactions for product advancement, and work closely with clinical operations to provide advice and decision making regarding medical input to achieve operational excellence. 

The candidate must have demonstrated effective collaborative skills to work across various phases of clinical development and serve as a key medical expert for multiple cross functional teams.  This position will provide medical insight across a myriad of functions from discovery to manufacturing are expected.  Additionally, the Medical Director will play a pivotal role in leading investigator engagements including travel to support face-to-face interaction and protocol training.  Prior experience in a mid-sized, fast-growing pharmaceutical environment is preferred, as this role will be working on product development in an extremely fast-paced and intense environment.   The Medical Director will serve as a leader on one multiple potentially pivotal programs. 

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Significant Oncology Experience the role will require expertise in the treatment and management of oncology disease such that knowledge can be applied to the strategy and clinical development of Summit medicines to benefit patients
  • Work cross functionally with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Commercial and other functions to develop the overall product strategy in multiple indications
  • Work cross functionally with Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacovigilance, and other functions to successfully complete clinical development programs leading to BLA approvals
  • Lead teams to execute on clinical development goals (clinical trial execution, clinical development strategy, medical affairs planning)
  • Manage direct reports or cross functional team members as needed based on team needs
  • Contribute to the communication strategy of Summit products via publications, manuscripts, abstracts, posters and scientific presentations
  • Making vital contributions on pivotal programs in clinical development program 
  • Directing human clinical trials, phases 1-3, for lead candidate in development, helping to ensure all clinical development milestones are met including enrollment goals
  • Participating in medical review of adverse event reports and monitoring of incoming safety data in conjunction with product safety/pharmacovigilance, including evaluating and escalating safety signals 
  • Coordinate and develop information for reports submitted to FDA, EMA, PMDA, and government, regulatory, or partner agencies  
  • Presentations to various external stakeholders - regulators, governing and harmonization bodies, principle investigators, scientific conference attendees, advisors and opinion leaders 
  • Knowledge of clinical trial conduct to support operational needs for planning and executing clinical trials, including adherence to protocols, safety reviews, assay development, training, and clinical document review 
  • Planning, reviewing and editing Clinical Study Reports 
  • Planning, reviewing and editing publications from the program
  • Providing input on the design of clinical studies supporting clinical strategy 
  • All other duties as assigned

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

  • Board certified or eligible MD with hematology/oncology product development and experience across stages of clinical development 
  • Minimum of 5+ years’ experience in pharmaceutical, biologics, or biotech R&D environment, or in a research environment involving the collection and analysis of human data in the area of hematology/oncology
  • Working knowledge of clinical development pathways for hematology/oncology therapeutics in the US and EMA 
  • Self-starter who will move forward with key initiatives without being prompted, able to perform a myriad of tasks needed to support the clinical development program, possesses a highly entrepreneurial and growth mindset, works collaboratively with cross-functional teams, loves a good mission

What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.

  • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.

Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.

Lieu : Télétravail aux États-Unis ou au Canada


Pourquoi DSSS ?

Data Sciences Staffing Solutions (DSSS) est une division d'IQVIA qui fournit à ses clients des ressources entièrement intégrées grâce à un partenariat de fournisseur de services fonctionnels (FSP). Vous bénéficiez ainsi de tous les avantages de travailler pour une CRO internationale leader du secteur et de collaborer directement avec les équipes multidisciplinaires de nos clients. Parmi nos clients figurent des entreprises pharmaceutiques et biotechnologiques de renommée mondiale, vous offrant des occasions uniques d'influencer l'avenir de la médecine et de contribuer à la commercialisation de nouvelles thérapies.

Résumé du poste :

Le biostatisticien principal est responsable du soutien statistique apporté aux essais cliniques pharmaceutiques menés auprès de patients.

Avantages supplémentaires :

• Possibilité de télétravail.

• Équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée et horaires flexibles.

• Collaboration avec des équipes de recherche et de statistiques motivées et performantes.

• Formation technique et programme de développement personnalisé.

• Possibilités de recherche qui correspondent à vos compétences.

• Perspectives de carrière prometteuses. • Stabilité d'emploi : contrats à long terme et possibilités de redéploiement.

• Priorité à la commercialisation de nouvelles thérapies plutôt qu'aux budgets de projets et aux avenants.

• Expérience des soumissions réglementaires.

• Environnement de travail stimulant et dynamique.

• Bon équilibre travail-vie privée.

Responsabilités :

• Collaborer avec des équipes de projet multidisciplinaires pour établir les objectifs et les échéanciers des projets.

• Effectuer les calculs de taille d'échantillon et de puissance statistique pour optimiser la conception des études.

• Rédiger les plans d'analyse statistique.

• Collaborer avec les équipes de gestion des données, de développement clinique et d'opérations cliniques en apportant son expertise statistique.

• Rédiger ou réviser les spécifications des ensembles de données d'analyse et des fichiers TLF.

• Programmer la validation des ensembles de données d'analyse d'efficacité, ainsi que des tableaux, listes et figures (TLF).

• Encadrer et superviser les programmeurs dans la rédaction des spécifications des ensembles de données d'analyse et la programmation/validation des tableaux, listes et figures (sécurité, etc.).

• Interpréter les résultats des études et vérifier l'exactitude des rapports de résultats.

• Contribuer aux analyses exploratoires. • Participer aux activités liées aux demandes d’autorisation de mise en marché (AMM) ou aux demandes d’autorisation de mise en marché de nouveaux médicaments (IND ou NDA).

• Assurer le suivi des activités des projets internes et des CRO, notamment les échéanciers, les livrables et la disponibilité des ressources.

• Contribuer à la rédaction des rapports d’études cliniques et autres documents réglementaires, tels que les demandes d’AMM, les DSUR (rapports quotidiens de données), les documents de synthèse, les ISS (rapports d’évaluation initiale des études), les ISE (rapports d’évaluation initiale des études), les SCE (résumés de l’efficacité clinique) et les SCS (résumés de la sécurité clinique).


Qualifications requises :

• Doctorat en statistiques, biostatistiques ou domaine connexe, avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie.

• Maîtrise en statistiques, biostatistiques ou domaine connexe, avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie.

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans les essais cliniques de phase 2/3.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le soutien aux simulations, au calcul de la taille de l'échantillon et à l'évaluation de la puissance statistique.

• Capacité démontrée à travailler de manière proactive et autonome.

• Capacité de communiquer efficacement des concepts statistiques et de collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

• Maîtrise des logiciels R ou SAS pour la réalisation d'analyses. • Soutien à la préparation de divers dossiers réglementaires

• Connaissance des recommandations de la FDA, des BPC de l'ICH, de l'ICH E9, ainsi que des pratiques et normes du secteur

• Expérience en validation/programmation d'ADAM et de TLF

• Expérience avec CDISC, notamment SDTM, ADAM et CDASH

• Solide compréhension des estimandes et des méthodes d'imputation multiple


Expérience souhaitée :

•Rédaction de documents à l'intention des autorités réglementaires

• Au moins un an d'expérience dans le domaine thérapeutique de l'immunologie

• Méthodes bayésiennes


Remarque - Nous avons des rôles de statisticien principal dans tous les domaines du FSP - Phase précoce et Phase tardive, alignés sur diverses études thérapeutiques.

English Job Description:

Data Sciences Staffing Solutions, DSSS, is a unit within IQVIA that provides our sponsors with fully embedded resources through a Functional Service Provider (FSP) partnership. The Principal Biostatistician is responsible for providing statistical support for pharmaceutical clinical trials in patients.

  • Home-based remote working opportunities.
  • Work/life balance as well as flexible schedules.

  • Experience with regulatory submissions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams to establish project objectives and timelines.
  • Perform samples size and power calculations for optimizing study design
  • Author statistical analysis plans.

Qualifications (Required)

  • Experience in validation/programming of ADAM and TLF
  • Experience with CDISC, including SDTM, ADAM, CDASH

Desired Experience:

  • Supporting written communications with regulators.

  • Bayesian methods

Come join us!

Corporate Sales is verticalized with a focus on accounts ranging from mid market to the Fortune 1000 across Life Sciences, Technology, Media and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, Consulting, and Consumer Packaged Goods. Within Corporate Sales, our High Growth organization is responsible for both net new and expansion business, driving new logo acquisition while deepening AlphaSense's footprint within existing customers.

We're looking for an exceptional Sales Director to lead a team of Mid-Market or Enterprise Account Executives within our High Growth organization, driving our culture, performance, and revenue growth across both net new and expansion business. This is a unique career opportunity to join a hyper-growth organization, work alongside exceptional leaders to learn from, and influence strategy, culture, and execution.

  • A Strategic Thinker: A big-picture thinker with a clear growth strategy for both new business and expansion, able to inspire and unify teams around a shared purpose and execute with a commitment to excellence.

  • A Complex Sales Expert: Experienced in managing complex SaaS sales cycles, with a focus on continuous sales process optimization, across both new business and expansion motions.

jobs.description:
A little about us
When it comes to food experience, me&u helps you always feel like a local. The company's vision is to bring that feeling to everyone, anywhere. No matter what neighbourhood you live in or visit, you'll always know the perfect place to go and exactly what to order.
me&u is used by 6000+ bars, pubs, and restaurants to create memorable guest experiences and grow their brands. With 200 staff in five countries, and headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, me&u is the consolidation of two leading hospitality technology companies: Mr Yum and me&u, who merged in November 2023.

The Engineering role is changing.
We're looking for a Staff or Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our Reservations stream. You'll take on ambiguous problems, own solution design and help shape the technical direction of the systems your team builds. We’re looking for someone whose judgment and standards lift the work of the whole team, not just their own.
We believe in full-breadth engineers, a.k.a the uncomfortably named 'broken comb' shaped people with multiple areas of expertise, who can deliver value end-to-end in a small, fully cross-functional team.
We build AI-natively. Agents do most of the implementation here; engineers shape the problem, write the specs and context that let agents succeed, and own the quality of what ships. You'll be expected to work this way from day one and lead by example, setting the standard for how the team works with agents. What good context looks like, which guardrails are executable rather than written down, and when AI output is good enough versus when it needs a human hand.
We already work this way: the AFR profiled how our engineers run agents overnight so their days go to customers and problems, not keyboards.

What you'll do
  • Co-create with product and design: Sit in discovery & hear directly from customers. Then bring your technical acumen into shaping, and turn intent into specs and story slices that both humans and agents can work from.
  • Direct and verify, then ship: Plan work so agents can execute it, review their output for logic and design rather than syntax, and take accountability for what lands in production.
  • Build the foundations agents inherit: Maintain the context files, skills, hooks, architectural lint rules and regression suites that make our codebases safer to delegate into over time, not riskier.
  • Own solution and system design: Lead the design of initiatives and features, working with product, design and the relevant custodianship leads to validate ideas and make trade-offs. Think across components and domains so solutions fit the system as a whole and the business goals behind them.
  • Code reviews: Review AI-generated and human-written PRs with the same rigour. Enforce our conventions, make actionable suggestions, and help decide which classes of change can eventually be trusted with lighter review.
  • Collaboration and mentorship: Pair with and mentor less experienced team members, including on how to work well with agents. Actively create room for mid-level engineers to grow, and make sure the team's use of AI consistently lifts its output.
  • Knowledge sharing and technical leadership: Champion our engineering principles, take part in our engineering guilds and help shape our architecture and practices. When customer needs, tech debt and delivery pace pull in different directions, make a clear directional call and document the reasoning so people and agents can make follow-on decisions without escalating.
  • Own the outcome: Guide your own work and the people and agents working alongside you towards timely, efficient delivery. Before shipping customer-facing changes, think through second-order effects, including support load, venue operations and billing edge cases, and adjust the approach without being asked. Own the customer outcome and the systems you build. Your job is to deliver value to our customers, not to get the code into production.

What you'll need
  • Agentic fluency: Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in production work: plan mode, worktrees, hooks, and choosing the right model for the task. You can show us a codebase you made easier for agents to work in.
  • Distributed systems: Commercial experience designing and running distributed systems and microservices on a cloud platform (AWS preferred).
  • Backend: Strong in at least one backend language such as TypeScript (Node.js), C#, Python, Ruby or Java. TypeScript/Node.js is a strong advantage.
  • Across the stack: Comfortable in React on the front end and with relational or document databases on the back, and able to design and implement REST or GraphQL APIs.
  • Quality and operations: Test-driven habits, observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) and practical web security.
  • Product judgment: Experience working closely with product managers and designers, and comfort talking to customers directly. You can explain what you're building and why to someone outside engineering.
  • Problem solving: Ability to take on complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into a clear, buildable path.
  • Communication: Ability to write system designs, give constructive feedback in review, and keep stakeholders in the loop.
  • Attention to detail: Willingness to take responsibility for the quality of engineering solutions, including performance, scalability and maintainability.

Nice to have
  • Experience in hospitality, payments or another regulated, high-volume consumer domain.
  • Experience with distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

Why me&u?
Work with impact and purpose. We’re helping the hospitality and entertainment industries to thrive, and me&u is at the forefront of this.
Work with great people. Join a supportive, diverse, and inclusive team. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn, and have fun along the way.
Work that challenges you. We’re growing quickly, which means endless opportunities to grow your career too.
Work that works for you. Flexible, remote-friendly work with inclusive leave options, mental health days, and wellbeing support.
Diversity and Inclusion Commitment
We’re committed to growing and empowering an inclusive me&u community. That’s why we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you require accessibility assistance at any stage of the process, please let us know.

jobs.excerpt: About Us:insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate.
jobs.description:
About Us:

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description:

We are looking for an accomplished engineering leader and testing expert who will establish and lead a Quality Center of Excellence (QCoE) to transform how ~700 engineers across insightsoftware approach automated testing and quality practices.

This is not a traditional QA management role. You will lead a small team of test automation experts who partner directly with product engineering teams — not to own their testing, but to diagnose quality gaps, teach sustainable testing practice, and build lasting capability. A critical gap we see across the organization is over-reliance on slow, brittle end-to-end tests and under-investment in the acceptance and contract-testing layers that should catch most regressions faster and more reliably. You will help teams build healthy test pyramids, achieve fast feedback loops, and reach high/elite DORA outcomes (elite deployment frequency, low change failure rates, and fast lead times).

You will operate as a program manager and strategic advisor: aggregating quality maturity signals across the portfolio, prioritizing where the QCoE engages based on risk, and reporting portfolio-level insights to engineering leadership so they can drive investment in the teams and practices that matter most. This role requires influence without authority, deep expertise in test automation architecture, and a commitment to building sustainable, healthy testing practices at scale. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering, giving you strategic visibility and the authority to prioritize QCoE engagement across the portfolio.

Your team will help engineering teams leverage AI-powered testing tools — intelligent test generation, test prioritization, self-healing test automation, and predictive quality analytics — as force multipliers. Teaching teams when and how to use these tools effectively, grounded in sound testing architecture, is part of the QCoE mission.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Assessment & Risk Management

  • Define and maintain a quality maturity model/scorecard across all engineering teams, measuring test pyramid health (unit vs. acceptance vs. integration vs. E2E ratios), automation coverage, test reliability/flakiness, and alignment with DORA metrics.
  • Conduct regular portfolio reviews to identify systemic quality risks, gaps, and anti-patterns — e.g., teams over-indexing on E2E tests, missing acceptance-layer testing, or carrying high technical debt in test infrastructure.
  • Aggregate quality signals across the organization and translate technical findings into business risk language for engineering leadership; establish a regular reporting cadence (e.g., quarterly) to communicate quality maturity trends and engagement impact.
  • Use maturity data and risk assessment to prioritize where the QCoE engages next — ensuring scarce coaching resources are allocated based on strategic impact and risk, not by whoever escalates loudest.

Test Pyramid & Test Architecture Coaching

  • Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose their current testing approach, identify pyramid imbalances, and co-design a healthier mix of unit, acceptance/contract, integration, and E2E tests.
  • Build and teach reusable test automation patterns, frameworks, and 'golden path' templates that engineering teams adopt themselves — focusing on contract/consumer-driven testing (e.g., Pact), API/service-level testing, and right-sized functional test suites.
  • Help teams reduce brittle, slow E2E test suites by building out acceptance and contract-testing layers that provide faster, more reliable feedback and reduce the need for end-to-end test coverage.
  • Coach teams on test sustainability: identifying and remediating flaky tests, designing for test maintainability, and building test infrastructure that scales with the codebase.

DORA-Driven Engagement & Capability Building

  • Work with Engineering Managers to identify gaps in DORA outcomes (deployment frequency, change failure rate, lead time, MTTR) and prescribe automation practice changes to improve them; make the connection explicit between test pyramid health and deployment velocity.
  • Run hands-on enablement: bootcamps, office hours, embedded pairing sessions, and internal certification/maturity models for test automation practice that teams can self-assess against.
  • Establish a test automation practice maturity model to benchmark teams' progress over time and celebrate wins; create a culture where excellent automation practice is the norm, not the exception.

AI-Enhanced Testing & Tool Evaluation

  • Evaluate, pilot, and guide adoption of AI-powered testing tools and agentic solutions — including intelligent test generation, test prioritization, self-healing test automation, and predictive quality analytics.
  • Coach teams on when and how to use AI-driven quality tooling effectively; establish guardrails so AI tools amplify good testing practices rather than substitute for sound test architecture.
  • Stay current with emerging AI/agentic testing solutions and communicate opportunities and risks to leadership.

Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Hire, manage, and mentor a small team of senior test automation engineers who bring deep expertise to coaching and technical problem-solving.
  • Build and maintain a culture of speed, excellence, collaboration, mentorship, and psychological safety within the QCoE; model the coaching and enabling mindset you expect your team to embody.
  • Collaborate across product, engineering, and operations; negotiate and align with Engineering Managers/Directors on remediation roadmaps when teams' practices pose delivery or reliability risk.

Qualifications

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Deep Quality & Test Architecture Expertise — Mastery of test pyramid design, contract/consumer-driven testing, API/service-level testing, and test sustainability; proven ability to diagnose and fix test anti-patterns.
  • Coaching & Enablement Mindset — Strong desire to teach and build capability in others rather than own execution; experienced at influencing engineering teams without formal authority; comfort with ambiguity and iterative problem-solving.
  • Program Management & Portfolio Thinking — Able to aggregate data across many teams, prioritize scarce resources against risk, and drive alignment with senior stakeholders; experienced at turning technical findings into business-relevant language.
  • DORA-Fluent — Working knowledge of DORA metrics (deployment frequency, change failure rate, lead time, MTTR) and how test automation practice maturity drives them, especially for multi-tenant SaaS products.
  • Leadership & Communication — Excellent written and oral communication; strong presence with senior engineering leadership and product teams; demonstrates psychological safety, openness to feedback, and a learning mindset.
  • Technical Fluency with AI/Agentic Solutions — Foundational understanding of AI concepts, prompt engineering, and ability to evaluate AI-powered testing tools; comfort learning and experimenting with emerging technologies.
  • Discipline & Perseverance — Focus and commitment to solving complex problems through to completion; relentless pursuit of sustainable, healthy testing practices.
  • Results Orientation — Strong bias toward action; able to set priorities, deliver measurable outcomes, and demonstrate impact through metrics and stakeholder feedback.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Hands-on testing and software quality assurance experience in fast-paced, iterative environments, including multi-tenant SaaS products.
  • Experience testing SaaS/multi-tenant products deployed on-demand with continuous deployment cadence, including familiarity with: progressive deployment patterns (canaries, feature flags, staged rollouts), testing strategies that account for multiple versions running simultaneously, and how continuous deployment shapes the balance of test types (fast feedback loops vs. comprehensive coverage).
  • Deep expertise in test pyramid strategy and how to rebalance testing toward fast, reliable feedback — with hands-on experience across unit, acceptance/contract, and integration testing layers, and demonstrated track record of helping teams reduce over-reliance on E2E suites.
  • Proven experience coaching or consulting with engineering teams on testing best practices — influence-without-authority is the primary skill, not direct execution or ownership of testing.
  • Expert background in test automation with a demonstrated record of tactical execution and strategic leadership in test automation and quality engineering programs.
  • Coding proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., C#, Java, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience with CI/CD principles, tools, and infrastructure; solid understanding of version control and source control management tools (e.g., GitHub, Azure DevOps).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GitHub), containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and multi-tiered infrastructure.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments and with Agile metrics (or willingness to learn DORA metrics deeply).
  • Experience evaluating, piloting, or implementing AI-powered testing tools or agentic solutions for test automation, test data generation, or quality intelligence.
  • Experience building or presenting quality maturity scorecards/dashboards and communicating technical risk to VP+ or leadership audiences.
  • Desirable: Experience with REST APIs, databases, and SQL; experience building or mentoring test automation frameworks; experience in financial software, SaaS, or similar complex product domains.

jobs.description:
Senior Quality Engineer

Help shape the future of assessment technology by leading quality engineering across two mission-critical Pearson platforms: ExamDeveloper, our exam authoring and management platform, and OnVUE, our industry-leading remote proctoring and exam delivery solution. You will drive testing excellence, automation maturity, and release confidence across platforms that support the full assessment lifecycle, from exam creation through secure exam delivery.

Also known in the market as: Senior QA Engineer, Senior Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineering Lead, Senior Quality Engineer, Test Automation Lead.

About the Role

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will serve as a technical authority for quality across one or more product domains. You will lead quality strategy, test planning, automation initiatives, and release readiness efforts while partnering with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps, security, and operations teams.

This role combines hands-on testing and automation with leadership through influence. You will help solve complex quality challenges, strengthen automation practices, mentor fellow quality engineers, and ensure the reliability, security, accessibility, and scalability of products used by millions of learners, certification candidates, and testing organizations worldwide.

The Opportunities

We are currently hiring multiple Senior Quality Engineer positions across our ExamDeveloper and OnVUE product teams:

  • OnVue / Exam Developer - OnVUE offers a growth and governance opportunity across online proctoring and vendor partnerships. ExamDeveloper needs transformation, quality improvement and more sustainable processes. Final product alignment will be discussed during screening.

jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a global leader in end-to-end third-party enterprise software support, managed services and Agentic AI ERP innovation solutions, dedicated to helping clients realize extraordinary business outcomes.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.


We are seeking a Staff Engineer, Agentic Solutions and Reusable Platforms, Innovation Solutions to join our team. Reporting directly to the GVP of Innovation Solution Delivery, this remote position is open to qualified candidates located in Australia or New Zealand (ANZ).

About the team


Rimini Street’s Innovation Solutions group builds and delivers agentic AI for enterprise customers on top of their existing ERP estate (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite and others), on the major hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on our own agentic platform. Engineering operates from three global centers (India, Malaysia, Brazil) alongside client-facing delivery teams, and makes heavy use of AI coding tools.


Our software operates inside enterprise systems of record. Defects carry financial, statutory and operational consequences for the customer.


The role


Take what we build for one customer and make it the fastest path to the next. Identify what is reusable in delivered solutions, extract it into frameworks, patterns, reference implementations and an engineering approach that the whole group builds to, and work with product and delivery leadership to turn proven solutions into repeatable offerings.


The role is hands-on. Expect to own architecture, build proofs of concept, work in the codebase and take on the harder technical problems alongside the engineering teams.


The role works directly with the Group Vice President and progressively takes ownership of technical areas he currently leads personally. It requires someone who understands the enterprise ERP and agentic AI landscape, operates independently and can be trusted to drive technical direction across the engineering side of the group.


The role works in conjunction with the Rimini Street certification process, which is the overall governance process for how we deploy agentic AI. The certification process defines the requirements a solution must meet. This role owns the engineering patterns and practice that meet them.


What you’ll do


  • Turn delivered solutions into reusable assets. After each customer build, identify what is generic, separate it from what is customer-specific, and extract it into frameworks, libraries, integration patterns and reference implementations that delivery teams can apply to the next customer.
  • Shape repeatable offerings. Work with product, delivery and commercial leadership to convert successful solutions into defined, scoped and priceable offerings with a standard build approach.
  • Own the reference architecture and engineering patterns for agentic solutions on ERP. Integration and tool contracts, identity and permission propagation, data boundaries, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation and observability, and deployment across SAP, Oracle and the hyperscalers.
  • Anchor the ERP side of the estate. Set the technical approach for agentic solutions over Oracle E-Business Suite and SAP, build the first reference implementations, and guide the integration engineers in the engineering centres.
  • Build the agentic capability further. Architect and prototype new agentic solutions, prove them on real customer problems, and carry the successful ones through to production-grade components.
  • Hold the production bar. One definition of production-ready, stated in explicit and testable terms, applied to platform work and to the work delivery teams take to customers. Define what must be true before prototype work is promoted to supportable product.
  • Own the engineering standards and the software development lifecycle of record across the engineering centers: specification-driven development, review practice, definition of done, release cadence, and the pipeline that enforces them.
  • Progressively take ownership of technical areas led by the Group Vice President today, including platform architecture decisions, the multi-cloud portability approach, the internal engineering environment and build tooling, and technical arbitration between platform and delivery.
  • Develop engineers. Mentor, review and pair across the engineering centers, and raise reviewing and design capability across a growing and largely junior population.

What we’re looking for


  • 10+ years building and operating production software, including several years owning technical direction beyond your own delivery. We are open on years and on title; the requirement is demonstrated scope.
  • Deep hands-on ERP technical experience in Oracle E-Business Suite or SAP. Systems in live customer use, not prototypes, proofs of concept or pre-sales work. Working depth in the platform’s integration and extension surfaces: for Oracle, PL/SQL, Integrated SOA Gateway and REST, Oracle Application Framework and workflow; for SAP, ABAP, BAPI/RFC, IDoc and OData. Oracle E-Business Suite depth is particularly valuable to us.
  • Experience in a legislatively or regulatorily driven domain, such as financials and statutory reporting, payroll and superannuation, tax, privacy and data protection, or e-invoicing. These domains require externally defined correctness, fixed external deadlines and demonstrable evidence of compliance after the fact.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building agentic or LLM-based solutions: agents with tool and function calling, tool contracts, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails, and human-in-the-loop control, with at least one taken into real use.
  • A track record of turning bespoke work into reusable assets: frameworks, accelerators, patterns or libraries adopted by teams beyond the project that produced them.
  • A track record of setting engineering standards adopted by teams you did not manage, including standards that remained in place after you moved on.
  • Experience halting a release on quality or risk grounds, and the judgement to weigh that decision against its cost.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction without line authority, through contribution and credibility, and to operate independently once given a remit.
  • Current hands-on engineering capability.

Technical Competencies


Required working depth in the following. You should be able to design, build, operate and teach each of them.

  • Agentic system architecture: agent and tool design, orchestration, state and durable execution, human approval flows, evaluation and observability of agent behaviour.
  • ERP integration: the integration surfaces of at least one of Oracle EBS (PL/SQL, ISG, REST) and SAP (BAPI/RFC, IDoc, OData), with working familiarity with the other.
  • Identity, permissions and data boundaries in enterprise systems: named-user propagation, least privilege, auditability.
  • Software development lifecycle end to end: specification, design review, build, test, release, operate and support, including the entry and exit criteria between stages.
  • Release engineering and CI/CD: branching and trunk strategy, versioning, environment promotion, quality gating, reproducible builds, and use of the pipeline to enforce standards.
  • Test strategy: unit, integration, contract and end-to-end testing, negative testing, and evaluation suites for non-deterministic components.
  • Cloud platforms: working knowledge of AWS, Azure and GCP services relevant to running AI workloads, and the ability to keep solutions portable across them.
  • Software supply chain: dependency and secret scanning, software bills of materials, licensing position, and artefact provenance.
  • Engineering documentation: design documents, architecture decision records, specifications and runbooks.

Beyond the ERP depth above, no specific language, framework or cloud is required.


Nice to have


  • Deep Oracle E-Business Suite technical experience, and technical depth in both Oracle and SAP.
  • Experience with other Rimini-supported enterprise software, such as PeopleSoft or JD Edwards.
  • Experience across both a product engineering organisation and a services or delivery organisation, and in particular building products or offerings out of services work.
  • Experience establishing engineering discipline in an organisation that did not previously have it.
  • Experience working across multiple regions and time zones.

How this role fits


The role sits within Platform Engineering, reporting to the Vice President, Platform Engineering, and works directly with the Group Vice President, Innovation Solution Delivery on the technical areas it takes on. It works day to day with the engineering centers in India, Malaysia and Brazil, with APAC delivery leadership, with the certification and governance function, and with product leadership on the offerings it helps shape.


The role is based in Australia to provide working-hours coverage across both the engineering centers and APAC delivery teams.


Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,700+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 22 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Sr. Engineer, AI Cyber Security

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role


As Biogen's AI Security Engineer, you are a hands-on technical specialist responsible for securing the organization's rapidly expanding use of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. This role operates at the intersection of cybersecurity engineering and AI/ML systems — ensuring that AI deployments across Biogen are resilient against adversarial threats, data poisoning, model manipulation, prompt injection, and unauthorized data exposure.


The AI Security Engineer will design, implement, and operate security controls purpose-built for AI workloads — spanning model development pipelines, inference endpoints, training data protection, and AI-assisted automation platforms. This role is responsible for translating emerging AI threat frameworks (MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF) into actionable engineering controls that protect Biogen's AI investments without impeding innovation velocity.


This position requires a rare combination of software engineering depth, AI/ML systems knowledge, and cybersecurity expertise. The scope demands:


Deep technical proficiency across AI/ML security, cloud security, and application security — with the ability to build production-grade security tooling, not just assess or advise


Autonomous execution — independently identifying AI security gaps, designing solutions, and implementing them end-to-end without requiring constant direction


Adversarial mindset — thinking like an attacker to identify how AI systems can be subverted, manipulated, or exploited before threat actors do


Cross-domain fluency — bridging the gap between data science teams building AI and security teams protecting the enterprise, translating between both worlds.


What You’ll Do


AI Threat Detection & Response Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate detection capabilities for AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, training data poisoning, and adversarial input attacks
  • Develop and maintain AI security monitoring pipelines that correlate signals across LLM interactions, API gateways, and model inference endpoints
  • Engineer automated response playbooks for AI security incidents — including model quarantine, token revocation, and session termination
  • Continuously research emerging AI attack vectors and translate findings into detection signatures and prevention controls
  • Operate and tune CrowdStrike AI Runtime Defense (AIRD) and Microsoft Purview AI governance controls across the environment

AI Platform Security Engineering

  • Implement security controls across AI development and deployment platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, internal ML pipelines)
  • Secure model training environments — including data access controls, compute isolation, artifact signing, and pipeline integrity verification
  • Engineer guardrails for generative AI usage — content filtering, DLP integration, output validation, and session-level access controls
  • Design and enforce AI model governance controls including model registry security, version control integrity, and deployment approval gates
  • Perform security architecture reviews of new AI services and integrations before production deployment

AI Risk Assessment & Framework Implementation

  • Conduct technical risk assessments of AI systems using MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, and NIST AI RMF frameworks
  • Perform adversarial testing (red teaming) of AI models and AI-integrated applications to identify vulnerabilities before production deployment
  • Develop and maintain AI security standards, reference architectures, and secure development guidelines for AI/ML teams
  • Evaluate third-party AI services and vendor AI integrations for security posture, data handling practices, and supply chain integrity

Security Automation & AI-Augmented Defense

  • Build and maintain AI-powered security tools that augment the cybersecurity team's detection and response capabilities
  • Develop integrations between security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler) and AI/ML systems for intelligent threat correlation
  • Engineer automated security workflows using LLMs and agentic AI for threat hunting, alert triage, and incident investigation acceleration
  • Contribute to the security team's internal AI capabilities — including MCP server development, agent frameworks, and security data pipelines
  • Build and maintain security scoring engines and risk quantification models that drive prioritization decisions

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of combined experience in cybersecurity engineering, software engineering, and/or AI/ML systems
  • Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following domains:
  • AI/ML Security: LLM security, prompt injection mitigation, model robustness testing, adversarial ML, AI supply chain integrity
  • Cloud Security Engineering: AWS, Azure, or GCP security architecture and controls implementation at scale
  • Application Security: Secure SDLC, API security, code review, penetration testing, threat modeling
  • Security Operations: Detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR development, incident response, threat hunting
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python and demonstrable experience building production security tooling and automation
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain) and AI cloud services (SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Databricks)
  • Working knowledge of AI security frameworks: MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF
  • Experience with enterprise security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler, CyberArk, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of LLM architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning security implications, and agentic AI patterns
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related technical field required

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $140,000.00-$187,250.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Role Scope & Balance

  • Serve as the primary owner of small to medium-sized backlog items, including standalone User Stories, operational enhancements, and production fixes, allowing Product Owners and the Product Manager to stay focused on larger strategic initiatives.

Demos & UAT

  • Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), including test scenarios, tester coordination, issue tracking, and sign-off.

Application & Integration Support

AI-Enabled Delivery

Business Analysis & Technical Skills

  • Strong requirements gathering, documentation, and process analysis skills.

  • Experience supporting D365 or other enterprise business applications (D365 strongly preferred).

  • Technical aptitude to review D365 configuration (forms, business rules, security roles, Power Automate flows) and validate data using views or Advanced Find. Hands-on development is not required.

Tools & Delivery

  • Experience working on Agile delivery teams and managing work in Azure DevOps (ADO).
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs in day-to-day work, with the judgment to validate their output.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Visio).

Interpersonal & Working Style

  • Personable and approachable, with a track record of building trusted relationships with both business and technical teams.
  • Collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate differing priorities and perspectives while keeping work moving forward.
  • Curious and proactive, with a habit of asking clarifying questions and validating understanding before acting.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for business audiences.

Education, Training and Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Systems Analyst role.

BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 48 reports over the last 4 years and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

You will work with a dedicated global team on technically difficult problems involving cybersecurity, distributed systems, data engineering, machine learning, and SaaS product development. You will help turn raw and rapidly changing threat information into dependable product behavior. That means writing production services, defining clear boundaries between components, handling failure deliberately, and making results understandable to operators and customers.

📣 What you’ll be doing

You will builds Python and Go services, APIs, and customer features using shared data capabilities delivered by Platform Engineering. You'll work with security researchers to implement production detections and expose the supporting evidence through customer workflows. You'll own defined capabilities from technical design through testing, release, and production support, including resolving implementation details and integration requirements.

  • Build and maintain Python and Go services and APIs for product features and detections.
  • Design features around shared identities, evidence, relationships, and history. Reuse existing data capabilities and resolve interface requirements with Platform Engineering.
  • Turn researcher-developed detection methods into tested production services with defined inputs, outputs, and evaluation criteria.
  • Build APIs that expose threat evidence and support customer investigation workflows, working with Product and frontend engineers.
  • Implement reliable reevaluation and customer updates when underlying evidence or intelligence changes.
  • Test failure handling, detection regressions, and authorization boundaries.
  • Design for safe retries, idempotency, and predictable behavior in asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
  • Enforce tenant isolation and access controls; preserve evidence and source context for results.
  • Add observability, investigate production issues, and improve reliability and performance as usage grows.
  • Contribute designs, code reviews, estimates, and documentation; identify unclear requirements and dependencies.
  • Verify AI-generated code before incorporating it into production software.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • Experience building SaaS products and/or product features on shared data platforms.
  • Experience building, shipping, and supporting backend software in production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or Go, with willingness to develop proficiency in the other language.
  • Experience designing or implementing APIs and integrating services with databases and external or internal systems.
  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, distributed system failure modes, and practical reliability patterns.
  • Ability to write maintainable code and automated tests, review others’ work, and debug production behavior.
  • An understanding of secure software development, authorization, and protecting customer data.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into service designs and implementations, working with domain specialists to resolve unclear requirements.
  • Understanding of how data quality, freshness, relationships, and access permissions affect feature behavior and customer results.
  • Ability to document decisions and coordinate assigned work in a remote team.
  • Willingness to learn AI-assisted development practices and critically evaluate generated code.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Production experience with both Python and Go.
  • Experience with cybersecurity products, threat intelligence, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with Azure, event-driven architectures, or multitenant applications.
  • Experience building customer features on a data platform, including consuming shared APIs, data models, graph services, or analytical services.
  • Experience working with researchers or integrating ML outputs into production workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI development tools alongside automated testing and code review.

💻 Our environment

Our Azure-based environment includes Go and Python services, Event Hubs and Kafka-compatible messaging, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Explorer, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, Databricks for appropriate analytics and machine-learning workloads, Kubernetes, and Azure-managed compute services.

Experience with every component is not required. We care more about whether you understand the engineering principles underneath these technologies, can become productive in an unfamiliar environment, and can choose the appropriate combination of managed services and custom software.

At BforeAI, we're dedicated to building a diverse workplace based on merit, work ethics, and character, and we believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success! If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

We use an Employee of Record service to facilitate seamless global hiring processes and offer benefits tailored to the country where you will be working! For countries not supported by our EOR partner, talk to us about being a contractor. In all cases, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship so you will need to be authorized to work in the country you’re based in. Clipbook builds AI-powered media monitoring and analytics tools for communications, PR, and public affairs teams. We help them track, search, and make sense of coverage across text, audio, and video.

Our founding team has backgrounds at BCG, Bain, Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, the White House, and Congress, and has previously built startups backed by Sequoia, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Coatue, and NFX.

The Role

You'd be one of the first engineers at Clipbook — joining a small but mighty engineering team with engineers from Meta, Stripe, and AWS. You'll have real influence over architecture and technical direction, and what you build will ship to 200+ customers quickly.

What You'll Do

  • Architect & build across the stack. Make architectural decisions and implement solutions across the stack (Next.js, TypeScript, React, Python, Node, SQL/NoSQL). You have the conviction to quickly build from concept to deployment to seeing clients love our product.

  • Collaborate with customers. Work directly with users to understand pain points, join calls, hear what's working and what isn't, and rapidly iterate to deliver solutions that matter.

  • Tackle a wide breadth of engineering challenges. Our work spans AI, data engineering, backend, frontend, and more — so there's plenty of opportunity to find projects that match your strengths and interests. Some examples include:

    • AI/ML Integration: Productionize LLMs and classical ML models for real-world, high-uptime applications — including prompt execution, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems. Leverage the latest in generative AI tooling and frameworks.

    • Data Engineering: Build pipelines and infrastructure for ingesting, normalizing, and querying massive, multi-modal datasets (text, audio, video).

  • Shape Clipbook's engineering culture. As one of the first engineers, you'll influence everything — code quality, system design principles, documentation standards, testing, deployment, and how we build as a team. You'll mentor future hires and drive best practices. We believe leaders stay hands-on: even as we grow, everyone (including managers) continues to ship.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–10+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies. You've taken systems from zero to production and owned the full lifecycle.

  • Proficiency with web technologies (Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, etc.)

  • Genuine excitement to build quickly & ship fast. We care about getting things into users' hands and iterating from there.

  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with cloud-based services, containerization, and API development.

  • Experience optimizing data architectures for performance and cost.

  • You take ownership. When something is broken or unclear, you fix it or flag it without waiting to be asked.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You make reasonable calls with incomplete information, communicate them clearly, and adjust as you learn more.

  • Strong product sense and bias for action. We're a small team and can't afford analysis paralysis — we make decisions with incomplete information and learn from real customer feedback.

  • A future leader. You'll help shape our engineering culture and can quickly grow into engineering leadership as the company scales.

Bonus Points

    • LLM fine-tuning, RAG, RLHF, or eval pipelines

    • Comfort with asynchronous workflows, rate-limiting, and distributed systems

What This Role Is Not

We're hiring across the full stack with a focus on building product. This probably isn't the right fit if your background is primarily in firmware, embedded systems, hardware engineering, networking, or infrastructure/DevOps.

A Few Things Worth Knowing

  • We care more about what you ship than when or where you work, but this is an early-stage company growing fast. The pace reflects that. Our culture is intense and driven by H&H (hunger and hustle).

  • As one of the first engineers, you'll wear a lot of hats. There's no platform team to hand things off to yet.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: Early-stage grant with significant upside

Growth: A clear path to engineering leadership as we scale
